biases.debias: Report specific criticisms of institutional performance without suggesting the institution itself lacks purpose.
biases.example_text: As Israel pushes past the Litani, Lebanese question the purpose of UNIFIL
biases.unbiased_text: As Israel pushes past the Litani, Lebanese debate UNIFIL's effectiveness

biases.detail: Framing infrastructure achievements as unconvincing through public doubt assertions despite successful completion.
biases.debias: Report infrastructure completion and adoption rates separately from opinion polling on satisfaction.
biases.example_text: Egypt's new monorail offers a modern ride, but Cairo is still not convinced
biases.unbiased_text: Egypt's new monorail opens to passengers, with initial ridership data still being collected

biases.detail: Framing US involvement in foreign separatist movements through questioning rather than assertion creates conspiratorial atmosphere without making direct claims.
biases.debias: Report confirmed facts about separatist movements and international involvement without speculative connection questions.
biases.example_text: Alberta will vote in a referendum over whether to separate from Canada, but how is the US President involved?
biases.unbiased_text: Alberta will vote in a referendum over whether to separate from Canada. The US President has commented on Alberta's autonomy discussions.

biases.detail: Emphasizing removal of identity documents to frame medical evacuation as imprisonment rather than administrative processing.
biases.debias: Report medical evacuation logistics neutrally, distinguishing between security measures and deliberate detention.
biases.example_text: Palestinian patients stripped of their documents are confined inside a Baghdad medical centre.
biases.unbiased_text: Palestinian patients evacuated to Baghdad are awaiting document processing at a medical centre.

biases.detail: Tallying foreign leader visits as evidence of growing influence frames diplomacy as competitive achievement rather than routine engagement.
biases.debias: Report diplomatic visits as part of standard international relations without competitive tallying.
biases.example_text: China has hosted 26 leaders from 23 countries this year, underscoring its growing diplomatic and economic influence.
biases.unbiased_text: China has hosted 26 leaders from 23 countries this year as part of ongoing diplomatic engagement.

biases.detail: Using 'Doesn't seem qualified' in headline format to delegitimize appointees through rhetorical questioning rather than direct assertion.
biases.debias: State qualifications objectively based on verifiable credentials and relevant experience without framing through subjective questioning.
biases.example_text: 'Doesn't seem qualified': Who is Bill Pulte, acting US intelligence chief?
biases.unbiased_text: Bill Pulte appointed acting US intelligence chief: Background and qualifications

biases.detail: Using phrases like 'won't be allowed to embed' to presume hostile intent in visa decisions without direct evidence of such framing by authorities.
biases.debias: Report visa restrictions and stated rationales without inserting terminology that assumes covert operational intent.
biases.example_text: Squad's visas for the US haven't been issued, with Marco Rubio saying IRGC-linked members won't be allowed to 'embed'.
biases.unbiased_text: Squad's visas for the US haven't been issued, with Marco Rubio stating that individuals linked to the IRGC will not receive entry approval.

biases.detail: Treating animal-based event predictions as newsworthy content rather than entertainment trivializes sports coverage.
biases.debias: Exclude or clearly label animal prediction segments as entertainment novelty rather than presenting them as sports news.
biases.example_text: Shark predicts winning start for Brazil at FIFA World Cup.
biases.unbiased_text: A shark at an aquarium was part of a promotional event related to Brazil's World Cup match.

biases.detail: Elevating protests against foreign health facilities without substantiating underlying conspiracy-adjacent concerns frames legitimate disease preparedness as suspicious.
biases.debias: Clarify the scientific purpose of health facilities while reporting objections, avoiding amplification of unverified threat narratives.
biases.example_text: The plan has drawn backlash from  Kenyans as well as the country's union of healthcare workers.
biases.unbiased_text: Some Kenyans and healthcare workers have raised concerns about the facility, though the US maintains it is for disease surveillance and preparedness.

biases.detail: Questioning whether ceasefires exist through headline interrogatives while simultaneously reporting violations, implying the agreements are meaningless rather than merely breached.
biases.debias: Report ceasefire agreements as formal accords while documenting specific violations, without questioning the existence of the agreements themselves.
biases.example_text: Gaza, Iran, Lebanon: If ceasefires are in place, why do strikes continue?
biases.unbiased_text: Gaza, Iran, Lebanon: Strikes continue despite ceasefires

biases.detail: Elevating fan opposition to managerial appointments into newsworthy political crises based solely on prior national team coaching roles.
biases.debias: Report fan reactions as community sentiment without framing routine supporter disagreements as political controversies deserving international coverage.
biases.example_text: Celtic fans oppose Keane as potential manager after Israel role
biases.unbiased_text: Celtic fans divided on potential Keane appointment as manager

biases.detail: Framing routine visa application procedures as newsworthy diplomatic events requiring urgent international attention and resolution.
biases.debias: Report visa processing as standard administrative procedures without suggesting they represent extraordinary diplomatic hurdles or crises.
biases.example_text: Iran footballers hand passports to US embassy for World Cup visa approval
biases.unbiased_text: Iran footballers apply for US visas ahead of World Cup

biases.detail: Emphasizing the temporal proximity between a victim's anticipated joyful event and their death to maximize emotional impact and victimization narrative.
biases.debias: Report deaths factually without emphasizing the timing relative to planned celebrations or personal milestones.
biases.example_text: Muhannad Farwana never got to wear his wedding suit, Israel killed him in an air strike hours before his wedding.
biases.unbiased_text: Muhannad Farwana was killed in an Israeli air strike on the day he was scheduled to be married.

biases.detail: Treating satirical protest movements with unconventional names as legitimate political entities through neutral coverage that normalizes their framing.
biases.debias: Clarify the satirical or protest nature of movements with symbolic names while reporting their actual political demands.
biases.example_text: 'Cockroach Party' leader returns to India for first New Delhi protest.
biases.unbiased_text: Leader of satirical youth protest movement using 'Cockroach Party' branding returns to India for first New Delhi demonstration.

biases.detail: Framing routine visa processing delays or denials as deliberate diplomatic crises or discrimination campaigns.
biases.debias: Report visa issues as administrative matters unless there is clear evidence of discriminatory policy.
biases.example_text: Iranian officials say a 'large' number of key staff denied visas as the team is set to travel to Mexico.
biases.unbiased_text: Iranian officials said some staff members have not yet received US visas ahead of the team's World Cup participation.

biases.pattern: War economic impact household cost individualization
biases.detail: Translating geopolitical conflict into personalized household financial burden through precise dollar amounts to emphasize individual victimization.
biases.debias: Report economic impacts through aggregate indicators and market data without converting to individual household cost figures that personalize distant conflicts.
biases.example_text: On average, US households have spent $750 more in expenses due to the war, hitting middle and lower-income people hard.
biases.unbiased_text: The war has contributed to rising energy and commodity prices in the United States, affecting consumer costs.

biases.pattern: World Cup logistical policy reversal vindication
biases.detail: Framing FIFA's policy change on water bottles as a victory resulting from public backlash and official criticism rather than routine operational adjustment.
biases.debias: Report policy changes as administrative updates without constructing narratives of grassroots triumph over institutional decisions.
biases.example_text: New York Mayor Mamdani was among those critical of FIFA's decision to ban water bottles at World Cup stadiums.
biases.unbiased_text: FIFA reversed its water bottle policy at World Cup stadiums following feedback from officials and the public.

biases.detail: Elevating routine visa processing decisions into international diplomatic incidents that suggest deliberate political exclusion.
biases.debias: Report visa denials as administrative matters without inferring broader diplomatic significance unless officials explicitly frame them as such.
biases.example_text: Iran's ambassador to Mexico expressed concern over the reported denial of US visas to the World Cup delegation.
biases.unbiased_text: Iran's ambassador to Mexico said some World Cup delegation members did not receive US visas.

biases.detail: Using informal diminutive names (like 'baby Sam') instead of formal names in headlines to heighten emotional impact and victimization framing of Palestinian casualties.
biases.debias: Use the child's full formal name as provided by family members or official sources without diminutive terms.
biases.example_text: 'Lives turned in a second': Family of baby Sam, shot dead by Israel, grieve
biases.unbiased_text: 'Lives turned in a second': Family of seven-month-old shot dead by Israel grieves

biases.detail: Framing sports tournament climate conditions as a broader political or social crisis requiring expert warnings rather than standard venue planning considerations.
biases.debias: Present climate conditions as logistical considerations for the event without elevating them to crisis-level warnings.
biases.example_text: Climate experts warn that 25% of World Cup games could be played in very hot conditions, affecting fans and players.
biases.unbiased_text: Analysis shows that 25% of World Cup games will be played in hot conditions, with organizers preparing heat management protocols for fans and players.

biases.detail: Attributing political leader's responses to psychological vulnerability ('thin skin') rather than strategic calculation.
biases.debias: Describe the political response factually without psychological speculation about emotional sensitivity.
biases.example_text: A student parody account has rattled India's most powerful man and exposed just how thin his skin has become.
biases.unbiased_text: A student parody account has prompted a response from India's prime minister, raising questions about the government's approach to online criticism.

biases.detail: Emphasizing the unprecedented geographic spread of opening ceremonies as historically significant.
biases.debias: Report the multi-country hosting arrangement without elevating it to historic status.
biases.example_text: The 2026 World Cup begins with historic ceremonies across the US, Canada and Mexico, launching a record tournament.
biases.unbiased_text: The 2026 World Cup begins with opening ceremonies across the US, Canada and Mexico for the expanded tournament.

biases.detail: Using passive voice to obscure key details about perpetrators or victims while emphasizing certain aspects of an incident.
biases.debias: Use active voice construction and include all relevant identifying information available in balanced manner.
biases.example_text: US State Department confirms the fatality, but refuses to provide more information about the person's death in Yangon.
biases.unbiased_text: The US State Department confirmed a US diplomat died in Yangon and said a Thai woman is in custody, but declined to provide additional details about the death.

biases.detail: Framing sanctions or diplomatic measures as insufficient without providing objective criteria for adequacy.
biases.debias: Report on sanctions and their scope without editorial judgment on whether they meet unstated standards of sufficiency.
biases.example_text: Sanctions on settlers not enough: Target Israeli gov't, say campaigners
biases.unbiased_text: Campaigners call for sanctions to extend beyond individual settlers to include Israeli government officials

biases.detail: Describing a military UFC event at the White House as occurring 'in front of Donald Trump' frames the president as merely a spectator prop rather than event organizer or host.
biases.debias: Describe the president's role at events with neutral framing that acknowledges their organizational authority without editorializing.
biases.example_text: Fight time, undercard, stats and how to watch as Topuria and Gaethje tussle in front of Donald Trump at the White House.
biases.unbiased_text: Fight time, undercard, stats and how to watch as Topuria and Gaethje compete at the White House-hosted UFC event.

biases.detail: Framing a comedian's work as a survival mechanism through their cultural identity during conflict, elevating entertainment to existential necessity.
biases.debias: Report on comedians' work and career without framing their comedy as a survival strategy or existential response to geopolitical events.
biases.example_text: He's become one of the most prominent Palestinian voices in comedy, but can Mo Amer laugh through this moment?
biases.unbiased_text: Mo Amer has become one of the most prominent Palestinian voices in comedy, continuing to perform and create new material.

biases.detail: Presenting archaeological findings of female-led societies as newsworthy discoveries that validate contemporary gender politics.
biases.debias: Report archaeological findings based on their scholarly significance without framing them as validation of contemporary social movements.
biases.example_text: Archaeologists have discovered evidence of an ancient female-led society in the ruins of a city in present-day Turkiye.
biases.unbiased_text: Archaeologists have discovered evidence of social structures in the ruins of an ancient city in present-day Turkiye, with researchers analyzing patterns of governance and authority distribution.

biases.detail: Treating AI model predictions of sporting outcomes as legitimate forecasting worthy of news coverage, validating speculative technology.
biases.debias: Avoid treating AI-generated predictions as newsworthy content; report on actual outcomes and expert analysis instead.
biases.example_text: We asked four AI models to predict the winner of the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
biases.unbiased_text: The 2026 FIFA World Cup has begun, with sports analysts offering various predictions based on team performance, player fitness, and tournament history.

biases.detail: Amplifying social media backlash against celebrity statements on Palestine to construct narrative of widespread condemnation.
biases.debias: Report celebrity statements and measure actual response magnitude rather than amplifying selective backlash as representative.
biases.example_text: US actor Jerry Seinfeld is facing backlash after saying Palestine 'doesn't exist'.
biases.unbiased_text: US actor Jerry Seinfeld said Palestine 'doesn't exist' in a recent interview, generating responses on social media.

biases.detail: Framing dangerous substitute products as established alternatives rather than crisis-driven health hazards, normalizing life-threatening behaviors through neutral terminology.
biases.debias: Emphasize the health risks and crisis conditions forcing these dangerous substitutions rather than presenting them as viable alternatives.
biases.example_text: Smokers in Gaza turn to toxic molokhia nicotine cigarettes as tobacco prices surge, causing serious health risks.
biases.unbiased_text: Desperate smokers in Gaza are poisoning themselves with makeshift molokhia cigarettes after tobacco became unaffordable, exposing them to severe health risks.

biases.detail: Presenting theft of sports equipment as potentially meaningful sabotage through headline framing rather than as routine crime, implying targeted disruption without evidence.
biases.debias: Report equipment thefts as criminal incidents without implying coordinated targeting unless evidence supports such conclusions.
biases.example_text: England training equipment stolen ahead of squad's arrival in Kansas City
biases.unbiased_text: Training equipment bound for England's World Cup squad was stolen in Kansas City, local police confirmed.

biases.detail: Presenting technology export controls as barring foreigners from access rather than as national security measures, framing them as discriminatory restrictions.
biases.debias: Describe export controls neutrally as regulatory measures without presuming discriminatory intent or framing access as an entitlement.
biases.example_text: Foreigners barred from accessing top AI models, underscoring Donald Trump's policy of export controls over high tech.
biases.unbiased_text: The US government has directed Anthropic to restrict access to its most advanced AI models as part of export control policies.

biases.detail: Highlighting removal of political figure's name from institutions as newsworthy achievement rather than routine administrative action.
biases.debias: Report name changes as administrative updates without celebratory or vindictive framing unless there is broader significance.
biases.example_text: Trump's name has been removed from the Kennedy Center after a court ruling, but adorns many other things and places.
biases.unbiased_text: A court ruling resulted in the removal of Trump's name from the Kennedy Center; his name remains on other properties and venues.

biases.detail: Framing current allegations as part of a longstanding pattern to suggest systematic institutional behavior rather than isolated incidents.
biases.debias: Report allegations based on current evidence without presuming systematic historical patterns unless comprehensively documented.
biases.example_text: Sexual violence against Palestinians in Israeli custody is often framed as a post-October 7 issue. But historical record
biases.unbiased_text: Reports of sexual violence against Palestinians in Israeli custody have emerged, with some analysts examining whether similar allegations have occurred historically.

biases.detail: Describing a deal as simultaneously 'complete' and requiring further signing ceremonies, creating confusion about its actual status while projecting momentum.
biases.debias: Clarify the precise stage of negotiations by distinguishing between preliminary agreements, signed documents, and implementation timelines.
biases.example_text: The Deal with the Islamic Republic of Iran is now complete
biases.unbiased_text: The US and Iran have reached a preliminary agreement, with formal signing scheduled for Friday.

biases.detail: Presenting one party's claim that multiple issues are necessarily connected as established fact rather than a negotiating position.
biases.debias: Attribute linkage claims to specific parties and note that different actors may view issue connections differently.
biases.example_text: Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson says ending the war in Lebanon is an 'inseparable' part of the US-Iran agreement.
biases.unbiased_text: Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson stated that, from Tehran's perspective, ending the war in Lebanon should be included in the US-Iran agreement.

biases.detail: Foregrounding the specific young age of child casualties in headlines to maximize emotional impact and frame incidents as particularly egregious.
biases.debias: Report child casualties with factual age information in context without using age as the primary emotional framing device in headlines.
biases.example_text: Israeli forces kill three-year-old Palestinian boy on family farm in Gaza
biases.unbiased_text: Israeli forces killed a Palestinian child and wounded his father on a farm in Gaza, according to family members.

biases.detail: Emphasizing location details that favor one narrative while omitting geographic proximity that would reveal logistical coordination challenges.
biases.debias: Include all relevant geographic details that affect operational feasibility without selective omission.
biases.example_text: US visa rules leave Senegal's World Cup fans behind
biases.unbiased_text: Senegalese fans face visa processing challenges for World Cup matches in North America

biases.detail: Characterizing standard operational decisions or logistical challenges as deliberate oppression or persecution.
biases.debias: Describe logistical decisions as operational matters without imputing systematic persecution motives.
biases.example_text: Iran coach says team 'oppressed' by travel chaos after World Cup NZ draw
biases.unbiased_text: Iran coach criticizes travel logistics after team forced to relocate between matches

biases.detail: Presenting contradictory qualities of a leader side-by-side without clarifying context, creating confusion about intent or meaning.
biases.debias: Provide the full context of remarks to clarify whether contradictory characterizations are complimentary, critical, or contextually dependent.
biases.example_text: President Donald Trump praised Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi as a "killer" and an "angel" at the G7 in France.
biases.unbiased_text: President Donald Trump made remarks about Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi at the G7 in France, calling him both a "killer" in negotiations and an "angel" in diplomatic relations.

biases.detail: Amplifying accusations of bribery regarding diplomatic agreements without explaining the nature of negotiated incentives or settlements.
biases.debias: Distinguish between negotiated incentives in diplomacy and corrupt bribery, providing proper context for what agreements entailed.
biases.example_text: US President Donald Trump has accused his predecessor Barack Obama of 'bribing' Iran to agree to the 2015 nuclear deal.
biases.unbiased_text: US President Donald Trump criticized his predecessor Barack Obama's approach to the 2015 nuclear deal, characterizing the economic sanctions relief as improper inducement to Iran.

biases.detail: Pre-labeling a political candidate with ideological terms in headlines before describing their positions or qualifications.
biases.debias: Describe candidates' positions and qualifications before applying ideological labels, allowing readers to form their own assessments.
biases.example_text: US progressive Lewis George on track to become DC mayor after Trump threats
biases.unbiased_text: US Democrat Lewis George on track to become DC mayor after Trump threats

biases.detail: Framing an athlete's inability to travel as being 'unauthorised' due to an arrest, implying legal restriction rather than administrative process.
biases.debias: Clarify whether travel restrictions are legal requirements or administrative decisions by sports authorities.
biases.example_text: Wahi was unauthorised for travel after he was reportedly arrested last month in a French spot-fixing investigation.
biases.unbiased_text: Wahi was denied entry to Canada after he was reportedly arrested last month in a French spot-fixing investigation.

biases.detail: Emphasizing victim nationality in headlines before context to maximize emotional impact and regional identification.
biases.debias: Present incident context before nationality markers to avoid emotional manipulation through identity framing.
biases.example_text: Three killed in Ukraine a day after drone attack kills child in Moscow
biases.unbiased_text: Casualties continue in conflict with three killed in Ukraine and one child killed in Moscow drone attack

biases.detail: Connecting professional body sanctions to unproven allegations through headline juxtaposition suggesting guilt.
biases.debias: Separate factual professional actions from ongoing investigations without implicit causation links.
biases.example_text: British lawyers' body suspends ICC Prosecutor Khan over misconduct claim

biases.debias: Apply consistent treatment to all leaders' rhetoric. Apply consistent granularity standards when reporting casualties across all parties to avoid humanizing one side disproportionately. Present buffer zone policies as contested security claims subject to negotiation rather than fait accompli territorial reconfigurations.
biases.example_text: 'Blatantly racist': Death penalty law among 'worst legislation' in Israeli parliamentary history
biases.unbiased_text: Critics describe Israel's new death penalty legislation as discriminatory, while supporters argue it addresses security concerns
detail_items: Selective distancing from Trump rhetoric: Uses quotation marks around Trump's inflammatory statements but not around other leaders' equally strong claims.

Casualty specification asymmetry: Provides precise nationality and injury details for US troops (nationality of wounded, concussion counts) while using aggregate numbers for Iranian or other casualties.

Buffer zone territorial permanence framing: Emphasizing Israeli statements about permanent population exclusion and systematic destruction in buffer zones as irreversible territorial transformation rather than temporary security measures.

Cultural heritage universalization appeal: Framing archaeological site destruction as crimes against 'all of humanity' rather than specific national heritage loss to elevate moral stakes beyond immediate parties.
Infrastructure-as-weapon scholarly framing: Desalination systems academically reframed as geopolitical leverage tools and wartime vulnerability axes through expert interview.
Discriminatory planning policy attribution: Bedouin shelter shortage attributed to 'discriminatory planning policies' rather than security infrastructure challenges.

Ceasefire denial amplification asymmetry: Emphasizes Iranian denial of Trump's ceasefire claim with terms like 'baseless' in headlines while downplaying possibility Trump statement was strategic signaling.
Allied NATO faith erosion framing: Emphasizes how leadership contradictions undermine confidence in alliance commitments rather than focusing on policy substance.
Infrastructure trophy targeting dramatization: Destruction of Iran's 'tallest bridge in the Middle East' is emphasized through superlative framing to amplify symbolic loss.
Child militia war crime pre-accusation: Framing Iranian recruitment of minors for defense as war crime preparation before actual combat deployment occurs.
Multi-alignment strategy collapse framing: Emphasizes Iraq's inability to maintain neutrality between competing powers, framing diplomatic balancing acts as unsustainable rather than adaptive.
War crime concern preemptive legal framing: Leading with expert legal assessment that threatened actions constitute war crimes before they occur.
Civilization extinction rhetoric amplification: Foregrounding Trump's 'whole civilization will die' language to dramatize existential threat framing.
Multi-alignment collapse inevitability: Framing Iraq's neutrality strategy as unsustainable under regional conflict pressure.

Constraint-over-strength ceasefire framing: Characterizes the US-Iran ceasefire as emerging 'from constraint' rather than strength, emphasizing limits of military escalation over diplomatic achievement.

Expectations disappointment base framing: Frames the ceasefire as failing to meet Netanyahu's base expectations of 'regime change' or 'something very dramatic,' emphasizing domestic political disappointment.
Survival-as-victory threshold lowering: Explicitly states 'for Iran, survival was always a victory,' reframing mere continuation as strategic success despite heavy losses.
Information war persistence framing: Characterizing ongoing disputed ceasefire interpretations as continuation of 'information war' rather than negotiation ambiguity.
Trust deficit negotiation framing: Emphasizing Iran's claim that the US failed to 'earn' trust positions diplomatic failure as character-based rather than substantive disagreement.

biases.detail: Embeds reporter opinions and atmospheric descriptions into reporting. Uses expert analysis segments that editorialize.
biases.debias: Separate factual claims from reporter commentary when summarizing.
biases.example_text: A fragile two-week truce between Iran and the United States hung in the balance on Wednesday
biases.unbiased_text: The two-week truce between Iran and the United States faced new challenges on Wednesday. Iran's parliament speaker posted on X that the 'workable basis on which to negotiate' had been violated.
detail_items: Embeds reporter opinions and atmospheric descriptions into reporting. Uses expert analysis segments that editorialize.

biases.detail: Palestinian official statement that settlers and Israeli army are 'one and the same' presented without qualification or context.
biases.debias: When reporting partisan claims of equivalence between civilian and military actors, note the distinction in roles and legal status.
detail_items: Palestinian official statement that settlers and Israeli army are 'one and the same' presented without qualification or context.

biases.detail: Focuses on paramilitary online psychological operations designed to suppress dissent through public displays of force.
biases.debias: Report intimidation tactics factually while noting both state security concerns and civil liberties implications equally.
detail_items: Focuses on paramilitary online psychological operations designed to suppress dissent through public displays of force.

biases.detail: [Trump profanity amplification] Prominently features Trump's expletive-laden social media posts in headlines and ledes, maximizing shock value and controversy. | [Child soldier recruitment war crime pre-positioning] Iranian Revolutionary Guards recruiting children as young as 12 is framed as imminent war crime liability before deployment occurs. | [Rescue operation daring valorization] Emphasizes the 'miraculous' and 'most daring' nature of pilot rescue operations, amplifying US military capability narratives. | [Geopolitical broker self-legitimization amplification] Pakistan's mediator role elevated through detailed diplomatic process coverage and ambassador platform access disproportionate to historical mediation track record. | [Toll proposal outrage amplification] Highlighting emotional reactions ('fuels outrage') to Iranian Strait of Hormuz toll proposal rather than technical feasibility analysis.
biases.debias: Paraphrase vulgar content professionally while preserving substantive meaning without sensationalism. Report recruitment campaigns with legal context but avoid pre-emptive war crime designation before battlefield deployment. Report rescue operations factually without superlative language that valorizes military actions.
detail_items: Trump profanity amplification: Prominently features Trump's expletive-laden social media posts in headlines and ledes, maximizing shock value and controversy.
Child soldier recruitment war crime pre-positioning: Iranian Revolutionary Guards recruiting children as young as 12 is framed as imminent war crime liability before deployment occurs.
Rescue operation daring valorization: Emphasizes the 'miraculous' and 'most daring' nature of pilot rescue operations, amplifying US military capability narratives.

Geopolitical broker self-legitimization amplification: Pakistan's mediator role elevated through detailed diplomatic process coverage and ambassador platform access disproportionate to historical mediation track record.
Toll proposal outrage amplification: Highlighting emotional reactions ('fuels outrage') to Iranian Strait of Hormuz toll proposal rather than technical feasibility analysis.

biases.detail: Multiple strikes on civilian sites are aggregated as a 'disturbing trend' to suggest systematic targeting pattern rather than individual incidents.
biases.debias: Report each strike with available targeting rationale rather than pre-aggregating into pattern accusations.
detail_items: Multiple strikes on civilian sites are aggregated as a 'disturbing trend' to suggest systematic targeting pattern rather than individual incidents.

biases.detail: Emphasizing record-breaking or symbolic status of infrastructure targets to suggest deliberate psychological warfare tactics.
biases.debias: Report infrastructure damage with factual descriptions without emphasizing symbolic or morale-impact dimensions.
detail_items: Emphasizing record-breaking or symbolic status of infrastructure targets to suggest deliberate psychological warfare tactics.

biases.detail: Geolocating evidence that Gulf allies' territory is being used for attacks despite their denials to expose hypocrisy.
biases.debias: Present evidence-based verification findings without framing as deliberate exposure of allied complicity.
detail_items: Geolocating evidence that Gulf allies' territory is being used for attacks despite their denials to expose hypocrisy.

biases.detail: Highlights geolocated video evidence of missiles launched from Kuwait despite denials, emphasizing exposure of allied complicity.
biases.debias: Report military operations from allied territory without emphasis on contradiction or complicity exposure.
detail_items: Highlights geolocated video evidence of missiles launched from Kuwait despite denials, emphasizing exposure of allied complicity.

biases.detail: Emphasizing that a negotiator is not a cleric as a notable characteristic, implying clerical dominance as the default expectation.
biases.debias: Present negotiator profiles based on relevant experience and authority without framing clerical/non-clerical status as exceptional.
detail_items: Emphasizing that a negotiator is not a cleric as a notable characteristic, implying clerical dominance as the default expectation.

biases.detail: Highlighting the specific number of delegation members as an indicator of seriousness or commitment to negotiations.
biases.debias: Focus on negotiating mandate and authority rather than delegation headcount as a proxy for commitment.
detail_items: Highlighting the specific number of delegation members as an indicator of seriousness or commitment to negotiations.

biases.detail: Emphasizing that a political figure is the first non-clerical leader in a prominent role suggests religious leadership is the norm.
biases.debias: Report on political appointments without unnecessary religious comparisons unless directly relevant to the story.
biases.example_text: The 70-member Iranian delegation taking part in negotiations in Pakistan today is being led by one of Tehran's most prominent non-clerical figures, Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf.
biases.unbiased_text: The 70-member Iranian delegation taking part in negotiations in Pakistan today is being led by Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf.

biases.detail: Highlighting civilian status through explicit denial of participation in conflict to amplify victimhood narrative.
biases.debias: Report civilian casualties without framing them through explicit declarations of non-belligerence.
biases.example_text: Residents of Iraqi Kurdistan are exhausted. Just 24 hours before the ceasefire, a civilian was killed in a drone attack blamed on Iran by Kurdish authorities. In total, around 700 drone and missile attacks have targeted US positions and certain Kurdish interests. Victims' loved ones are devastated by the war between Iran and the United States, of which they are the indirect victims.
biases.unbiased_text: Residents of Iraqi Kurdistan face ongoing drone attacks. A civilian was killed 24 hours before the ceasefire in an attack attributed to Iran by Kurdish authorities. Around 700 drone and missile attacks have targeted US positions and areas in Kurdistan.

biases.detail: Asserting that leaders have fundamentally misunderstood cultural or national psychology, positioning expert as having superior insight.
biases.debias: Present expert assessments of diplomatic approaches without claims of psychological misreading.
biases.example_text: Donald Trump hasn't read the psychology of the Iranians well at all
biases.unbiased_text: The current approach may not align with Iranian negotiating patterns, according to military analysts.

biases.detail: Characterizing diplomatic meetings as merely symbolic or performative rather than substantive, preemptively delegitimizing potential outcomes.
biases.debias: Report on diplomatic meetings as exploratory or preliminary without prejudging their substantive value.
biases.example_text: Israeli-Lebanese negotiations 'largely symbolic and performative', Middle East expert says
biases.unbiased_text: Middle East expert Aaron David Miller suggests the Israeli-Lebanese negotiations face significant structural challenges, noting that 'none of the participants in today's meetings have the authority to negotiate' binding agreements.

biases.detail: Amplifying claims that adversarial parties share objectives (like 'liberation') to suggest consensus where fundamental disagreement exists.
biases.debias: Distinguish between stated diplomatic positions and actual policy objectives, noting areas of fundamental disagreement.
biases.example_text: Israel, Lebanon united in liberating Lebanon from Hezbollah, Israeli ambassador to US says
biases.unbiased_text: Israel's ambassador to the US stated that Lebanese officials expressed opposition to Hezbollah's influence, though Lebanon has not publicly endorsed Israeli military objectives or terminology regarding Hezbollah.

biases.detail: Elevating diplomatic social media disputes over editorial choices to major news stories, amplifying controversy beyond its significance.
biases.debias: Report magazine covers as editorial decisions without disproportionate focus on diplomatic Twitter reactions.
biases.example_text: Prominent left-leaning Italian weekly L'Espresso is at the centre of a diplomatic storm online, after the Israeli ambassador to Italy slammed its choice of front cover as "manipulative".
biases.unbiased_text: Italian weekly L'Espresso featured an armed Israeli settler on its cover, prompting criticism from Israel's ambassador to Italy.

biases.detail: Presenting apartheid as an inevitable outcome contingent on specific policy failures, using authoritative sources to frame political preferences as predictions.
biases.debias: Report political opinions about potential outcomes as viewpoints rather than conditional certainties.
biases.example_text: Israel is "heading to apartheid" unless it divides the land with the Palestinians.
biases.unbiased_text: Former Shin Bet head Ami Ayalon argued that without a land division agreement with Palestinians, Israel risks creating an apartheid-like system.

biases.detail: Characterizing militant groups as occupying state territory through framing language suggesting foreign occupation parallels.
biases.debias: Describe armed groups' territorial presence without occupation language that conflates them with foreign invaders.
biases.example_text: The ​Lebanese government made ​it clear during U.S.-brokered talks ​with ‌Israel ⁠that ‌they no longer want to ⁠be "occupied" by Hezbollah
biases.unbiased_text: The Lebanese government indicated during U.S.-brokered talks with Israel that they want Hezbollah to reduce its military presence

biases.detail: Characterizing negotiations as complicated by non-state actors while implicitly legitimizing those actors as parallel authorities.
biases.debias: Clearly distinguish between recognized state authorities and non-state actors without blurring sovereignty lines.
biases.example_text: The central issue is that Israel is not confronting the Lebanese state, but rather Hezbollah, a hybrid political and militant group.
biases.unbiased_text: A key challenge is that Hezbollah, designated as a terrorist organization by multiple countries, operates within Lebanon despite not representing the Lebanese state.

biases.detail: Describing peace talks as limited or symbolic before they occur or before outcomes are known.
biases.debias: Report on diplomatic efforts without prejudging their effectiveness or characterizing them as performative.
biases.example_text: Israeli-Lebanese negotiations 'largely symbolic and performative', Middle East expert says
biases.unbiased_text: Middle East expert assesses Israeli-Lebanese negotiations as they begin in Washington.

biases.detail: Emphasizing Israeli use of AI-generated images as unique misconduct without contextualizing broader AI manipulation trends in conflict zones.
biases.debias: Report AI manipulation incidents as part of broader information warfare patterns used by multiple parties.
biases.example_text: The Foreign Press Association has accused the Israeli military of discrediting a Lebanese journalist it killed in March, by using an AI-generated photo to present him as a 'Hezbollah terrorist.'
biases.unbiased_text: The Israeli military acknowledged posting an AI-altered photo of a Lebanese journalist killed in March, overlaying his press vest with military imagery.

biases.detail: Emphasizing counts of alleged ceasefire violations by one party while presenting the ceasefire announcement as a diplomatic achievement.
biases.debias: Report violations factually from all parties or avoid selective counting that suggests blame before investigation.
biases.example_text: the Lebanese army has already reported several alleged violations in the southern border region
biases.unbiased_text: The Lebanese army has reported incidents in the southern border region during the ceasefire period that it characterizes as violations.

biases.pattern: AI manipulation admission as discrediting proof
biases.detail: Presenting admission of using AI-altered images as definitive evidence of systematic delegitimization campaigns rather than isolated incidents.
biases.debias: Report AI image incidents as specific cases without generalizing to broader patterns unless multiple instances are documented.
biases.example_text: The Foreign Press Association has accused the Israeli military of discrediting a Lebanese journalist it killed in March, by using an AI-generated photo to present him as a 'Hezbollah terrorist'.
biases.unbiased_text: The Israeli military posted an AI-altered photo of journalist Ali Shoeib after killing him in an airstrike. The Foreign Press Association criticized the action.

biases.detail: Emphasizing a country's or region's own mediation role or security initiative as newsworthy while minimizing other actors' contributions.
biases.debias: Report all diplomatic initiatives proportionally without emphasizing one's own country's role more prominently.
biases.example_text: French President Emmanuel Macron and British Prime Minister Keir Starmer on Friday hosted a video conference with their European allies to discuss the possible deployment of a multinational force to the Strait of Hormuz
biases.unbiased_text: Multiple countries held discussions Friday about a possible multinational force to secure the Strait of Hormuz

biases.detail: Framing current crises as vindication for claims about insufficient military or defense spending, particularly in one's own region.
biases.debias: Report defense policy debates without using current events as proof of previously held positions about spending levels.
biases.example_text: 'Wake-up call for Europeans to step up: There's been a lack of investment' in defence
biases.unbiased_text: Analysts discuss European defense spending levels in light of current Middle East security challenges

biases.detail: Treating the use of AI-altered imagery by an actor as conclusive proof of broader deception or illegitimacy rather than as one disputed claim.
biases.debias: Report disputed imagery incidents factually without extrapolating to character judgments about the actor's overall credibility.
biases.example_text: The Foreign Press Association has accused the Israeli military of discrediting a Lebanese journalist it killed in March, by using an AI-generated photo to present him as a 'Hezbollah terrorist'.
biases.unbiased_text: The Foreign Press Association says the Israeli military posted an altered photo of a Lebanese journalist it killed in March, showing him in a Hezbollah uniform rather than his press vest; the IDF later acknowledged the image was edited.

biases.detail: Highlighting that violations occurred almost immediately after a ceasefire began to suggest bad faith, rather than reporting violations neutrally.
biases.debias: Report ceasefire violations with standard detail about timing without emphasizing speed as evidence of intent.
biases.example_text: A 10-day ceasefire agreement between Lebanon and Israel came into effect this Friday, though the Lebanese army has already reported several alleged violations in the southern border region
biases.unbiased_text: A 10-day ceasefire agreement between Lebanon and Israel came into effect Friday; the Lebanese army reported several alleged violations in the southern border region.

biases.detail: Characterizing a party's negotiation approach as duplicitous by describing it as oscillating between competing positions.
biases.debias: Describe negotiation strategies as pursuing multiple objectives or balancing interests without implying deception.
biases.example_text: Hussein Ibish, Senior Resident Scholar at the Arab Gulf States Institute in Washington, analyses Israel's strategy in Lebanon, which he describes as oscillating between negotiations and continued presence in the south.
biases.unbiased_text: Hussein Ibish, Senior Resident Scholar at the Arab Gulf States Institute in Washington, analyses Israel's strategy in Lebanon, which involves both negotiations and maintaining military presence in the south.

biases.detail: Presenting a party's denial of responsibility as suspicious by pairing it with an accusation from another party without equal weight.
biases.debias: Present denials and accusations with equal prominence and note that responsibility has not been confirmed.
biases.example_text: A French peacekeeper serving with United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon was killed and three others wounded in an ambush in southern Lebanon, with Emmanuel Macron blaming Hezbollah, which denies responsibility.
biases.unbiased_text: A French peacekeeper serving with United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon was killed and three others wounded in an ambush in southern Lebanon. Emmanuel Macron said Hezbollah was responsible, while Hezbollah has denied involvement.

biases.detail: Describes ceasefires as 'meant to be broken' in expert quotes, normalizing violation expectation rather than presenting it as one analysis among multiple perspectives.
biases.debias: Present expert skepticism as one analytical perspective rather than inevitable historical pattern.
biases.example_text: ceasefires in the Middle East, particularly in Lebanon, are often 'meant to be broken', reflecting a deeply pessimistic outlook
biases.unbiased_text: ceasefires in the Middle East, particularly in Lebanon, have historically faced challenges in implementation, according to one analyst's assessment

biases.detail: Emphasizes authoritarian durability through conflict survival narratives that portray regimes as strengthened rather than weakened by external pressure.
biases.debias: Report regime stability assessments without framing conflict as a source of internal political strengthening.
biases.example_text: the longer the conflict drags on, the less unpopular the Islamic Republic becomes domestically
biases.unbiased_text: analysts differ on how prolonged conflict affects domestic perceptions of the Islamic Republic

biases.pattern: Territorial doctrine buffer zone permanence insinuation
biases.detail: Frames military security zones as tools for territorial expansion rather than temporary security measures.
biases.debias: Report on security doctrines by presenting stated military objectives without interpreting unstated territorial ambitions.
biases.example_text: Drawing on recent developments in Gaza, Syria, and Lebanon, he argues that this doctrine operates as a legal façade for expanding occupation under the language of self-defence.
biases.unbiased_text: The analyst stated that Israel's Yellow Line doctrine designates areas where it claims security concerns require restricting access, which critics say exceeds defensive military needs.

biases.detail: Characterizes diplomatic positioning as performative maneuvering rather than substantive engagement in peace processes.
biases.debias: Report on pre-negotiation actions without dismissing them as merely tactical or ritualistic.
biases.example_text: According to Townsend, US–Iran negotiations are shaped by tactical manoeuvering: a pre-negotiation ritual in which both sides position themselves strategically through public posturing and calculated obstruction.
biases.unbiased_text: Townsend noted that both the US and Iran are taking public positions before formal negotiations, which is common in diplomatic processes.

biases.detail: Framing military confirmation of documented incidents as significant news rather than routine acknowledgment of evidence.
biases.debias: Report confirmations as procedural acknowledgments while focusing on the incident's substantive implications.
biases.example_text: The Israeli military confirmed a viral photo of one of its soldiers smashing a statue of Jesus with a sledgehammer in southern Lebanon is "authentic," and said its launched an investigation into the incident.
biases.unbiased_text: The Israeli military acknowledged the incident after a photo circulated showing a soldier destroying a statue of Jesus in southern Lebanon and said it opened an investigation.

biases.detail: Treating military confirmation of already-verified incidents as if it constitutes new investigative revelation.
biases.debias: Report confirmations as administrative acknowledgments rather than investigative breakthroughs.
biases.example_text: The Israeli military confirmed a viral photo of one of its soldiers smashing a statue of Jesus with a sledgehammer in southern Lebanon is "authentic," and said its launched an investigation into the incident.
biases.unbiased_text: The Israeli military acknowledged the viral photo of a soldier destroying a Jesus statue in southern Lebanon and said it would investigate the incident.

biases.detail: Framing a leader's first foreign visit destination as revealing strategic priorities or alliances through emphasis on sequence and symbolism.
biases.debias: Report diplomatic visits factually without inferring unstated strategic meanings from scheduling choices.
biases.example_text: Péter Magyar has made his first diplomatic priority clear. Before Brussels or Vienna, Hungary's prime minister-elect is heading to Warsaw to meet Donald Tusk.
biases.unbiased_text: Hungary's prime minister-elect Péter Magyar will visit Warsaw to meet Donald Tusk before traveling to Brussels or Vienna.

biases.detail: Portraying negotiations as the only viable path while dismissing alternatives as non-existent, removing agency from assessment.
biases.debias: Present negotiations as one option among several without declaring absolute necessity.
biases.example_text: Within this context, he frames negotiation with Israel not as a matter of choice, but of necessity — the only viable path toward stability, dignity, and the basic conditions for the Lebanese people to live and thrive.
biases.unbiased_text: Within this context, he frames negotiation with Israel as a path toward stability, dignity, and basic conditions for the Lebanese people to live and thrive.

biases.detail: Treating confirmation of already-circulated content as investigative discovery rather than administrative verification.
biases.debias: Report authentication as confirmation of existing information without treating verification itself as revelation.
biases.example_text: The Israeli military has confirmed a viral photo of one of its soldiers smashing a statue of Jesus with a sledgehammer in southern Lebanon is "authentic," and said it has launched an investigation into the incident.
biases.unbiased_text: The Israeli military verified a circulated photo showing one of its soldiers smashing a statue of Jesus with a sledgehammer in southern Lebanon and said it has launched an investigation into the incident.

biases.detail: Emphasizing civilian suffering from border closures to attribute blame for diplomatic disputes rather than reporting status neutrally.
biases.debias: Report border closure facts and diplomatic disputes without foregrounding humanitarian cost as primary narrative frame.
biases.example_text: Residents pay the price as Afghanistan-Pakistan border remains closed
biases.unbiased_text: The Afghanistan-Pakistan border has remained closed for six months amid diplomatic disputes

biases.detail: Highlighting alleged war criminals' inclusion in national celebrations to scandalize the host nation's moral standing.
biases.debias: Report participation in national events factually, noting accusations separately without scandal framing in headline.
biases.example_text: An extremist rabbi accused of war crimes has been selected to participate in Israeli Independence Day celebrations.
biases.unbiased_text: A rabbi facing war crimes accusations will participate in Israeli Independence Day celebrations

biases.pattern: Currency withheld as coercion tool framing
biases.detail: Characterizing financial holds as weaponized leverage 'bending' a country to another's will, emphasizing dominance rather than policy conditions.
biases.debias: Report financial holds with stated conditions and policy objectives rather than coercion metaphors.
biases.example_text: Washington uses Iraq's own oil money to bend Baghdad to its will
biases.unbiased_text: Washington has blocked Iraq oil revenue transfers to pressure Baghdad on militia policy

biases.pattern: Fossil fuel blackmail from autocracy premise
biases.detail: Presuming that fossil fuel dependency constitutes 'blackmail from war-driving authoritarian regimes' as inherent characteristic rather than contingent geopolitical reality.
biases.debias: Discuss energy security challenges without presuming supplier intent or characterizing all fossil fuel trade as coercion.
biases.example_text: EU 'must' shift to renewables to end fossil fuel 'blackmail from war-driving authoritarian regimes'
biases.unbiased_text: EU officials say shift to renewables would reduce energy dependence on countries currently in conflict

biases.detail: Amplifying official claims that a military operation has achieved global scope as evidence of decisive success.
biases.debias: Report military operation scope claims as official statements without characterizing them as validated achievements.
biases.example_text: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said Operation Epic Fury has achieved a decisive result in just weeks
biases.unbiased_text: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth stated that Operation Epic Fury is entering a new phase focused on preventing Iran from developing nuclear weapons.

biases.detail: Comparing bank bailouts to absence of humanitarian funding to suggest misplaced priorities without examining budget mechanisms.
biases.debias: Report humanitarian funding shortfalls without creating false equivalences to unrelated financial sector interventions.
biases.example_text: the world bailed out the banks, no one is bailing out the children
biases.unbiased_text: UNICEF is facing a significant funding shortfall for humanitarian operations supporting children affected by conflicts.

biases.detail: Leading with percentage of global oil supply affected to dramatize geopolitical standoff impact.
biases.debias: Report shipping disruptions with context about alternative routes and actual supply impacts rather than leading with percentages.
biases.example_text: Hormuz standoff chokes 20% of oil supply
biases.unbiased_text: The Strait of Hormuz standoff has disrupted maritime traffic through the waterway that typically handles a significant portion of global oil shipments.

biases.detail: Making legitimacy claims dependent on voter participation metrics that observers frame as credibility tests.
biases.debias: Report elections and turnout figures without conditioning sovereign legitimacy on external approval metrics.
biases.example_text: the vote would provide "credibility to Palestinian sovereignty" if voter turnout is high
biases.unbiased_text: The vote will determine local council composition with voter turnout expected to reflect public engagement levels

biases.pattern: Barometer metaphor reducing elections to opinion polling
biases.detail: Framing democratic elections primarily as measurement tools for public sentiment rather than governance selection processes.
biases.debias: Report elections as selection processes for officials while noting they may also reflect political attitudes.
biases.example_text: the vote serves as a "barometer" on Palestinian public opinion
biases.unbiased_text: The vote will select local council members and may indicate political preferences among participating voters

biases.pattern: Hiding leadership narrative through absence speculation
biases.detail: Constructing hiding or fear narratives from leader's public absence without confirming actual circumstances or reasons.
biases.debias: Report confirmed facts about leader appearances and activities without speculating about fear or hiding motivations.
biases.example_text: Mojtaba Khamenei lives in hiding, fearing for his life and participates in decision making by hand-written notes
biases.unbiased_text: Mojtaba Khamenei has not appeared publicly since being named supreme leader, according to media reports

biases.detail: Electoral atmosphere is characterized as 'festive and cheerful' to suggest legitimacy despite limited political participation.
biases.debias: Report election atmosphere factually without adjectives suggesting celebration or political validation.
biases.example_text: A festive and cheerful mood has taken hold of the West Bank as the Palestinian Authority holds local elections
biases.unbiased_text: The Palestinian Authority is holding local elections in the West Bank with voters participating in municipal contests.

biases.pattern: Parliamentary bill framing as fait accompli
biases.detail: Reports proposed legislation as if enacted policy, presenting parliamentary commission proposals with language suggesting implementation rather than deliberation.
biases.debias: Clearly distinguish between proposed bills, committee recommendations, and enacted law, emphasizing legislative process stage.
biases.example_text: The bill also proposes that any profits made from the strait should be paid in the Iranian rial currency.
biases.unbiased_text: The proposed bill includes a provision that would require profits from the strait to be paid in Iranian rial currency, though the measure has not been voted on.

biases.pattern: Trial legitimacy through in absentia participation emphasis
biases.detail: Highlights defendants tried in absentia while emphasizing physical presence of one defendant, creating legitimacy impression through procedural participation detail.
biases.debias: Report trial proceedings with clear context on absentia limitations, avoid suggesting legitimacy through selective emphasis on procedural elements.
biases.example_text: Assad and his brother Maher al-Assad, who fled Syria, are being tried in absentia, while former security official Atif Najib appeared in court in handcuffs.
biases.unbiased_text: A Syrian court began proceedings involving Assad and his brother in absentia, as both have fled the country. Former security official Atif Najib was present at the hearing.

biases.detail: Framing video documentation of destruction as validating observer testimony rather than as neutral evidence.
biases.debias: Present video evidence as documentation without implying it validates particular narratives or observer claims.
biases.example_text: Many videos document the Israeli army's destruction of houses and infrastructure in southern Lebanon, where it is creating a buffer zone along the border. Our Observers, many of whom wanted to return home after a ceasefire was announced, describe empty villages and razed homes.
biases.unbiased_text: Videos show extensive destruction of houses and infrastructure in southern Lebanon where Israeli forces have established a buffer zone. Residents returning after the ceasefire found widespread damage to villages and homes.

biases.detail: Elevating historians with family connections to conflicts as authoritative voices to suggest inevitability of group persistence.
biases.debias: Present historical analysis based on expertise rather than personal or ancestral connections to the subject matter.
biases.example_text: Rashid Khalidi has spent years writing a series of books on the region and its conflicts, often through the eyes of his own family. He says that millions of people are not going to leave their land, so there's a basis for the two peoples to figure something out.
biases.unbiased_text: Historian Rashid Khalidi, who specializes in Palestinian history, argues that demographic realities suggest both populations will remain in the region, creating conditions for potential negotiated solutions.

biases.detail: Frames content creators as deliberately blurring lines between categories, treating entertainment format as evidence of propaganda intent rather than analyzing content substance.
biases.debias: Analyze content on its factual claims and messaging without presuming format choice indicates deceptive intent.
biases.example_text: Viral pro-Iran AI memes blur lines between propaganda and entertainment
biases.unbiased_text: Viral AI-generated content about the Iran conflict uses entertainment formats while promoting political perspectives.

biases.detail: Highlighting approaching deadlines alongside stalled negotiations to create urgency pressure framing and suggest crisis escalation from procedural timelines.
biases.debias: Report deadlines as procedural facts without dramatizing the temporal pressure or framing lack of agreement as crisis intensification.
biases.example_text: With the deadline approaching and no agreement in sight, a decision remains out of reach.
biases.unbiased_text: Congress has not yet reached an agreement on authorization as the War Powers Resolution deadline approaches.

biases.detail: Describing situations or agreements as inherently fragile through conditional language that emphasizes precariousness over current stability.
biases.debias: Describe current conditions factually without emphasizing hypothetical fragility through 'despite' or conditional framing structures.
biases.example_text: despite a fragile situation that many Lebanese would find hard to describe as a true ceasefire
biases.unbiased_text: amid an ongoing ceasefire that has seen continued incidents

biases.pattern: Hospitalization urgency medicalization of political detention
biases.detail: Emphasizing severe medical deterioration and urgent hospitalization to characterize imprisonment as causing life-threatening harm.
biases.debias: Report medical transfers with available facts about condition and treatment without dramatic language implying imminent death unless medically confirmed.
biases.example_text: Iran's imprisoned Nobel Peace Prize laureate Narges Mohammadi has been urgently transferred from prison to hospital after what her foundation described as a severe deterioration in her health. She reportedly fainted twice on Friday.
biases.unbiased_text: Imprisoned Nobel Peace Prize laureate Narges Mohammadi was transferred from prison to hospital after fainting twice on Friday, according to her foundation.

biases.detail: Using literary language ('kinetic,' 'obscured by haze,' 'blur into a single flow') to frame military reporting as sophisticated observation rather than factual description.
biases.debias: Use precise technical language to describe military movements and capabilities without aesthetic embellishment or narrative dramatization.
biases.example_text: That complexity is not theoretical. It is kinetic, obscured by haze and shaped by 'about 300 small speedboats… bouncing along the water' at high speeds, forming a dense and ambiguous maritime ecosystem where smugglers, civilians and military actors blur into a single, indistinguishable flow.
biases.unbiased_text: Approximately 300 small speedboats operate in the strait at high speeds, including smugglers, civilian vessels and military craft that are difficult to distinguish from one another.

biases.pattern: Toll payment prohibition as sanctions expansion
biases.detail: Framing warnings against paying transit tolls as extending sanctions to humanitarian transactions, emphasizing secondary enforcement reach.
biases.debias: Report sanctions guidance as technical legal clarification about existing prohibitions rather than as expansionary enforcement action.
biases.example_text: The US Treasury on Friday warned shippers not to pay tolls to Iran for passage through the Strait of Hormuz, including charitable donations to organisations such as the Iranian Red Crescent Society
biases.unbiased_text: The US Treasury issued guidance Friday clarifying that payments for Strait of Hormuz passage, including to charitable organizations, are prohibited under existing sanctions.

biases.detail: Framing military technology adoption as sophisticated tactical evolution rather than simple weapon acquisition.
biases.debias: Report military technology deployment factually without characterizing it as strategic innovation or tactical sophistication.
biases.example_text: Hezbollah has since shifted tactics, with analysts pointing to an increased use of fibre optic drones that can evade Israeli jamming systems.
biases.unbiased_text: Hezbollah has increased its use of fibre optic drones, which are difficult to jam electronically.

biases.detail: Elevating athletes' collective criticism of tournament compensation as a unified pressure campaign for equity.
biases.debias: Report athlete compensation concerns by citing specific demands and tournament responses without framing as collective movement pressure.
biases.example_text: Players keep up the pressure on the Grand Slam tournaments by asking organisers to increase prize money.
biases.unbiased_text: Several top-ranked players have asked Grand Slam organizers to increase prize money.

biases.pattern: Between life and death urgency escalation
biases.detail: Using the phrase 'between life and death' rather than medical status descriptions amplifies drama and immediacy beyond clinical assessment.
biases.debias: Report medical emergencies using specific clinical information—condition severity, procedures required—rather than dramatic binary life-death framing.
biases.example_text: Jailed Iranian Nobel Peace Prize winner Narges Mohammadi is fighting for her life after being hospitalised under guard for the last five days with a heart condition, her supporters said on Tuesday.
biases.unbiased_text: Jailed Iranian Nobel Peace Prize winner Narges Mohammadi was hospitalised under guard five days ago with a heart condition that her supporters describe as serious, following two fainting episodes on Friday.

biases.detail: Declaring a ceasefire 'not over' or 'continuing' despite documented violations obscures the functional collapse of agreements through semantic insistence.
biases.debias: Report ceasefires as operational agreements whose status depends on compliance, noting violations as substantive changes rather than maintaining nominal continuity.
biases.example_text: US ​Defence ​Secretary Pete Hegseth told a Pentagon press conference on Tuesday ⁠that ‌the US-Iran 'ceasefire is not over'.
biases.unbiased_text: US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth told a Pentagon press conference on Tuesday that the US maintains the April ceasefire framework remains formally in effect, despite recent military exchanges in the Strait of Hormuz.

biases.detail: Repeatedly emphasizing that detention occurred 'in international waters' to suggest jurisdictional illegitimacy regardless of legal complexities.
biases.debias: Note location of detention factually once; avoid repetition that suggests predetermined legal conclusion about jurisdiction.
biases.example_text: The two men were seized in international waters last week while participating in a humanitarian aid flotilla seeking to break Israel's blockade of the Gaza Strip.
biases.unbiased_text: The two men were seized last week while participating in a humanitarian aid flotilla seeking to reach the Gaza Strip.

biases.detail: Characterizing military conflict as a psychological or theatrical contest over resolve and leverage rather than a military or political dispute.
biases.debias: Frame conflicts in terms of concrete military, political, or economic objectives rather than abstract psychological dynamics.
biases.example_text: In Ben Taleblu's account, the conflict is not merely military or economic, but psychological and performative: a contest over leverage, narratives, and perceived resolve.
biases.unbiased_text: In Ben Taleblu's account, the conflict involves military, economic, and diplomatic dimensions as both sides seek to advance their strategic objectives.

biases.detail: Characterizing a nation's foreign policy as attempting to gain benefits while avoiding corresponding responsibilities through paradoxical desire formulation.
biases.debias: Describe foreign policy goals directly without implying contradictory or impossible aspirations.
biases.example_text: China, she argues, wants influence without entanglement, stability without military overreach, and diplomatic leverage without assuming the burdens of American-style global policing.
biases.unbiased_text: China seeks to maintain regional influence and ensure energy security while limiting military involvement, according to the analyst.

biases.detail: Describing an economy as being 'on the verge' of collapse or 'asphyxiation' to emphasize imminent crisis rather than current economic strain.
biases.debias: Report current economic conditions and challenges without predictive language of imminent total collapse.
biases.example_text: Iran on the verge of economic asphyxiation -- rare footage from Tehran
biases.unbiased_text: Iran faces severe economic challenges including high inflation and restricted trade -- footage from Tehran

biases.detail: Highlighting that evidence of religious site desecration 'went viral' to emphasize public outrage rather than reporting the incident itself. Also: Highlighting that evidence of religious site desecration 'went viral' rather than focusing on the act itself or institutional response.
biases.debias: Report desecration incidents based on their factual occurrence, not their social media spread or virality. Report incidents of desecration with focus on the actions and responses rather than social media virality metrics.
biases.example_text: The Israeli military says it has launched an investigation after a photo showing one of its soldiers desecrating a statue of the Virgin Mary in south Lebanon went viral
biases.unbiased_text: The Israeli military says it has launched an investigation after a photo showed one of its soldiers desecrating a statue of the Virgin Mary in south Lebanon

biases.detail: Framing US policy to maintain Israel's military superiority as a deliberate mechanism to keep neighboring militaries weak rather than as stated security policy.
biases.debias: Report military aid policies and their stated objectives without interpreting unstated intentions to weaken other nations.
biases.example_text: But the US legal imperative to ensure Israel has a 'qualitative military edge' (QME) has kept the Lebanese military under-funded, under-equipped and unable to perform its role.
biases.unbiased_text: US policy requires maintaining Israel's military advantage, which has resulted in limited military aid to Lebanon.

biases.detail: Attributing complex economic impacts like tourism decline solely to a recent war while omitting other contributing regional factors or longer-term trends.
biases.debias: Present tourism data with multiple contributing factors and provide pre-conflict baseline comparisons for context.
biases.example_text: Since the Middle East war erupted in late February, Jordan's ancient city of Petra has been all but abandoned by the usual crowds of tourists that flock to the site every year.
biases.unbiased_text: Jordan's ancient city of Petra has seen a significant decline in tourist visits since late February, when the Middle East war began.

biases.detail: Structuring headlines to emphasize paradox between official ceasefire status and ongoing violence for delegitimization effect.
biases.debias: Report violations and ceasefire status separately without paradoxical framing.
biases.example_text: Israel strikes kill several in Lebanon despite truce
biases.unbiased_text: Israel carried out strikes in Lebanon on Saturday that killed several people, with daily exchanges of fire continuing three weeks after a ceasefire was announced.

biases.detail: Posing question about diplomatic seriousness in headline to imply answer through interrogative structure.
biases.debias: State diplomatic positions directly without question format that implies judgment.
biases.example_text: Iran keeps US waiting for response on ceasefire plan
biases.unbiased_text: Iran has not yet responded to the US ceasefire proposal, with negotiations ongoing through Pakistani mediators.

biases.detail: Emphasizing 'just weeks' until catastrophe creates artificial deadline pressure that may not reflect actual timelines or mitigation options.
biases.debias: Report urgency factually without countdown framing that implies imminent inevitability.
biases.example_text: The world has just weeks to prevent a crisis that could tip tens of millions of people into hunger and starvation if fertilisers are not allowed through the Hormuz strait, the UN warned Monday.
biases.unbiased_text: The UN warned that disruption to fertilizer shipments through the Hormuz strait could lead to food security challenges affecting millions.

biases.detail: Describing settler violence as occurring with 'full support of military' asserts institutional coordination as established fact rather than allegation.
biases.debias: Report allegations of military involvement in settler violence as claims requiring investigation rather than confirmed facts.
biases.example_text: He describes the settler violence devastating his community as systematic, insisting these are not random acts of brutality, but calculated attacks.
biases.unbiased_text: He describes the settler violence in his community as systematic and claims these are calculated rather than random attacks.

biases.detail: Using 'blackmail' to characterize one nation's control over strategic infrastructure that affects others, implying illegitimate coercion.
biases.debias: Describe strategic control over waterways or infrastructure without moral language, focusing on geopolitical leverage and affected parties.
biases.example_text: Qatar's top diplomat said on Tuesday that Iran should not use the Strait of Hormuz as a means to blackmail Gulf countries or as a 'weapon'.
biases.unbiased_text: Qatar's top diplomat said on Tuesday that Iran should not use control of the Strait of Hormuz to pressure Gulf countries economically.

biases.detail: Using medical metaphors like 'life support' for diplomatic agreements creates artificial urgency and frames negotiations as terminal patient scenarios.
biases.debias: Describe ceasefire status with factual assessments of compliance and violations without dramatic medical analogies.
biases.example_text: Trump says Iran ceasefire on 'life support' after rejecting Tehran counteroffer
biases.unbiased_text: Trump says Iran ceasefire is fragile after rejecting Tehran counteroffer

biases.detail: Quoting third-party characterizations of actions as 'blackmail' without attribution markers frames the accusation as factual assessment.
biases.debias: Attribute characterizations like 'blackmail' clearly to their source and balance with the accused party's framing.
biases.example_text: Qatar's top diplomat said on Tuesday that Iran should not use the Strait of Hormuz as a means to blackmail Gulf countries or as a 'weapon'.
biases.unbiased_text: Qatar's top diplomat said on Tuesday that Iran should not use the Strait of Hormuz to pressure Gulf countries, characterizing such actions as 'blackmail'.

biases.detail: Reporting on alleged secret actions while emphasizing their secrecy and lack of confirmation creates inherent credibility tension.
biases.debias: Report alleged secret actions with clear attribution and acknowledgment of unverified status.
biases.example_text: The United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia in April secretly carried out a series of air strikes against Iran during the US-Israeli war against Tehran, the Wall Street Journal and Reuters reported this week.
biases.unbiased_text: The Wall Street Journal and Reuters reported this week that the United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia allegedly carried out air strikes against Iran in April during the US-Israeli conflict with Tehran, though neither country has confirmed these reports.

biases.detail: Emphasizing the interval since last elections to suggest dysfunction or illegitimacy without explicit accusation.
biases.debias: Report electoral timing factually without implying impropriety through emphasis on duration.
biases.example_text: The Fatah party is due to elect its new central committee for the first time in 10 years.
biases.unbiased_text: The Fatah party is holding elections for its central committee.

biases.detail: Framing parliamentary dissolution proposals as seizing control rather than standard legislative procedure.
biases.debias: Report dissolution proposals as legislative actions without control-seizure language.
biases.example_text: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's ruling coalition seized control of the electoral timetable on Wednesday by submitting a motion to dissolve Israel's parliament early
biases.unbiased_text: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's ruling coalition submitted a motion to dissolve Israel's parliament early on Wednesday

biases.detail: Structuring headlines to emphasize actions occurring during negotiations as inherently contradictory or undermining.
biases.debias: Report concurrent events without implying automatic contradiction between diplomacy and military actions.
biases.example_text: Israel launches fresh strikes on Lebanon despite ceasifre and ongoing talks
biases.unbiased_text: Israel launches fresh strikes on Lebanon as ceasefire negotiations continue

biases.detail: Dismissing surface interpretations of events to suggest deeper hidden narratives through 'at first glance' construction. Also: Framing succession questions as superficial while asserting that deeper structural power dynamics are the real story.
biases.debias: Present multiple interpretations without privileging deeper conspiracy readings. Report succession debates and structural issues as distinct analytical layers without dismissing either as surface appearance.
