biases.unbiased_text: President Donald Trump canceled planned envoy travel to Pakistan, stating that communication with Iran could continue through other channels.

biases.detail: Attributing human-like deliberate decision-making to AI systems when describing technical failures or errors.
biases.debias: Describe AI errors as system malfunctions or programming outcomes rather than deliberate choices.
biases.example_text: The AI system, powered by Anthropic's Claude Opus model, had been handling a routine task when it independently chose to 'fix' an issue by wiping the data - without any human approval.
biases.unbiased_text: The AI system, powered by Anthropic's Claude Opus model, was handling a routine task when it executed a command that deleted the data without human approval due to its programming.

biases.detail: Framing potential business deals with absolute historical superlatives before completion or verification.
biases.debias: Report proposed mergers with conditional language and cite comparable historical deals for context.
biases.example_text: Deutsche Telekom already owns 53% of T-Mobile US. Now it wants the rest — in what could become the biggest corporate merger in history.
biases.unbiased_text: Deutsche Telekom already owns 53% of T-Mobile US and is now considering acquiring the remaining shares in what would be one of the largest telecom mergers.

biases.detail: Elevating doubts about media authenticity to headline status based on unverified social media speculation.
biases.debias: Report content with verified facts while noting ongoing authentication processes without amplifying speculation.
biases.example_text: Videos emerging on social media from Iran appear to show armed Iranian women parading with IRGC in several cities in an upsurge of nationalist and religious fervour, dubbed as a 'jihad of women', but some clips spark AI editing doubts and remain unverified.
biases.unbiased_text: Videos on social media show armed Iranian women parading with IRGC in several cities in what has been termed a 'jihad of women.' Verification of the videos is ongoing.

biases.detail: Characterizing public social media communication by governments as illegitimate compared to traditional diplomatic channels.
biases.debias: Report on diplomatic communications across all channels without assigning legitimacy hierarchies to the medium used.
biases.example_text: A senior Ukrainian diplomatic source told Euronews that "if Israel responded to other requests via diplomatic channels, there would have been no need for tweets", as Israeli FM Sa'ar lashed out at Kyiv over what he said was "Twitter diplomacy".
biases.unbiased_text: A Ukrainian diplomatic source said Israel had not responded to previous requests through traditional channels, while Israeli FM Sa'ar criticized Ukraine's use of social media to communicate diplomatic requests.

biases.detail: Framing diplomatic meetings as performative displays that mask underlying divisions through absence and signal emphasis.
biases.debias: Report on diplomatic meetings based on stated outcomes and commitments rather than speculation about symbolic gestures.
biases.example_text: Gulf leaders met in Saudi Arabia to address the fallout from the Iran war, projecting unity but stopping short of concrete steps as divisions and uncertainty persist.
biases.unbiased_text: Gulf leaders met in Saudi Arabia to discuss responses to the Iran war, though the meeting did not produce specific policy commitments.

biases.detail: Uses terminology like 'maritime freedom coalition' that frames one side's military coordination as principled defense of universal rights rather than strategic interest.
biases.debias: Describe military coalitions by their stated operational goals without adopting value-laden terminology that presumes moral legitimacy.
biases.example_text: US seeks 'maritime freedom' coalition to restart Strait of Hormuz shipping
biases.unbiased_text: US seeks multinational naval coalition to reopen Strait of Hormuz shipping.

biases.detail: Attributes military recruitment success directly to royal participation without evidence, suggesting symbolic gestures drive substantive policy outcomes.
biases.debias: Report recruitment trends and royal involvement separately unless causal connection is substantiated with evidence.
biases.example_text: The royal seal of approval, together with recruitment campaigns running across the media, has proven so successful that the military is now working overtime to arm, train and accommodate the influx of newcomers.
biases.unbiased_text: Netherlands military recruitment has increased following campaigns that included royal participation, with the military expanding training capacity for new reservists.

biases.pattern: Stolen resource accusation through descriptive certainty
biases.detail: Presents disputed claims about resource origin as established fact in headlines and descriptions, treating allegation as confirmed truth.
biases.debias: Attribute contested claims to their source and use conditional language until independently verified.
biases.example_text: Israel halts Russian grain ship amid stolen Ukrainian wheat row
biases.unbiased_text: Israel halts Russian grain ship amid dispute over Ukrainian allegations that wheat was taken without authorization.

biases.pattern: Privacy regulation compliance framing as suspicious
biases.detail: Presenting routine compliance with privacy laws as notable or potentially suspicious by explicitly mentioning the regulatory justification.
biases.debias: Report on arrests and detentions without highlighting standard privacy compliance as if it requires special explanation or raises questions.
biases.example_text: the suspect's name was not released, in line with Dutch privacy regulations
biases.unbiased_text: A suspect has been detained and will appear in court over an alleged plot to attack Dutch princesses.

biases.detail: Framing temporary security confiscation as permanent loss or disappearance to create victim narrative around inconvenience or bureaucratic process.
biases.debias: Report confiscations factually, distinguishing between temporary security holds and actual losses, with clear status of items.
biases.example_text: The Oscar belonging to the co-director of the documentary 'Mr Nobody Against Putin' has gone missing after the US' TSA would not allow him to carry statuette on his Lufthansa flight
biases.unbiased_text: The Oscar belonging to the co-director of 'Mr Nobody Against Putin' was confiscated by TSA at a US airport and has not yet been returned.

biases.detail: Highlighting 'ghost flights' terminology to emphasize environmental waste of regulatory compliance flying.
biases.debias: Report airline slot policies by explaining the rules and environmental impacts without using emotionally charged terminology.
biases.example_text: Carriers will also be able to hand back 'slots' at airports without punishment, removing the need to operate controversial 'ghost flights'.
biases.unbiased_text: Carriers will be able to return airport slots without penalty, eliminating the need to operate flights with few passengers to maintain those slots.

biases.detail: Framing children's evasion of safety measures as creative or surprisingly effective rather than as policy failure.
biases.debias: Report age verification effectiveness by stating factual bypass rates without characterizing evasion methods as creative or ingenious.
biases.example_text: A new report reveals that children across the UK are outwitting online safety measures with fake birthdays, borrowed IDs, and some surprisingly creative facial hair.
biases.unbiased_text: A new report reveals that children across the UK are bypassing online safety measures using fake birthdays, borrowed IDs, and drawn-on facial hair.

biases.pattern: Economic mirage terminology for statistical distortion
biases.detail: Using 'mirage' to characterize positive economic data as illusory when driven by specific corporate behavior.
biases.debias: Report economic statistics by explaining contributing factors without characterizing legitimate data as deceptive or illusory.
biases.example_text: Ireland's GDP soared 12.3% in 2025 — but it was a mirage. Pharma multinationals front-loaded €25.4bn of exports to the US in March alone, ahead of Trump's tariffs.
biases.unbiased_text: Ireland's GDP increased 12.3% in 2025, largely driven by pharmaceutical companies accelerating €25.4bn in US exports ahead of tariffs.

biases.detail: Framing sporting contests as opportunities for coaches to prove something shifts focus from team competition to individual redemption narratives.
biases.debias: Report sporting events as team competitions focused on tactics and performance rather than personalizing them as coaching vindication opportunities.
biases.example_text: Atlético Madrid and Arsenal meet tonight in London for a match that will decide who gets to play in the Champions League final, with each team's head coach going into the game with a point to prove.
biases.unbiased_text: Atlético Madrid and Arsenal meet tonight in London for a match that will decide who advances to the Champions League final, with both coaches seeking to lead their teams to the competition's showcase match.

biases.detail: Introducing cultural commentary with 'in the purge, you survive' creates an exclusionary gatekeeping narrative that divides audiences into worthy and unworthy based on prior knowledge.
biases.debias: Introduce lesser-known cultural subjects with welcoming framing that invites discovery rather than suggesting punishment for ignorance.
biases.example_text: Heard of them? Good. In the purge, you survive.
biases.unbiased_text: Whether you've heard of them or are discovering them now, Super Furry Animals deserve wider recognition as one of Wales' finest musical exports.

biases.detail: Emphasizing divisions and difficulties among negotiating parties immediately before crucial talks, framing agreement as unlikely.
biases.debias: Report upcoming negotiations factually without pre-emptively emphasizing divisions; allow outcomes to speak for themselves.
biases.example_text: MEPs and EU countries are facing growing pressure just hours before key talks on implementing the EU–US trade deal. However, officials warn that the Parliament's demands may be too ambitious to secure an agreement this evening.
biases.unbiased_text: MEPs and EU countries are preparing for key talks on implementing the EU–US trade deal this evening, with negotiations focused on Parliament's proposed provisions.

biases.pattern: Conditional mission framing through headline structure
biases.detail: Structuring headlines to emphasize conditionality or preliminary nature of military deployments rather than deployment itself.
biases.debias: Report military movements factually; note conditions or prerequisites separately without making them the primary frame.
biases.example_text: French carrier group moves south of Suez ahead of conditional UK-French Hormuz mission
biases.unbiased_text: French carrier group moves south of Suez as UK-French Hormuz mission planning continues

biases.detail: Emphasizing geographic origin of disease variant with implications of increased danger without clinical evidence of differential severity.
biases.debias: Report disease variants factually by scientific designation; avoid geographic naming that implies heightened threat without evidence.
biases.example_text: South African authorities have detected the Andean variant, which is contagious between humans.
biases.unbiased_text: South African authorities have detected a variant that is contagious between humans.

biases.detail: Attributing emissions differences to demographic categories with causal certainty rather than correlation, implying fixed behavioral patterns.
biases.debias: Report emissions research as correlation studies; avoid language suggesting demographic determinism of environmental behavior.
biases.example_text: Rich white men's jobs, diets and hobbies found to be 'bad for the planet'
biases.unbiased_text: Study finds correlation between higher incomes, certain occupations and increased carbon emissions

biases.detail: Framing resource consumption metrics as discrete calendar dates when resources are 'used up' to create urgency through temporal deadline narrative.
biases.debias: Present ecological footprint data as continuous metrics rather than discrete calendar events.
biases.example_text: Portugal has just used up its natural resources for 2026.
biases.unbiased_text: Portugal's ecological footprint has exceeded its biocapacity for the year, according to overshoot calculations.

biases.detail: Elevating individual tourist compensation claims into broader narratives about endemic problems through case-to-consequence extrapolation.
biases.debias: Report individual legal cases as isolated incidents without extrapolating to systematic industry-wide implications.
biases.example_text: A tourist has won compensation after claiming towel-hogging guests made sun loungers impossible to use on a Greek holiday – and the ruling could spell trouble for resorts that fail to tackle the 'sunbed wars'.
biases.unbiased_text: A German tourist won €900 in compensation from a tour operator after claiming sun loungers were unavailable due to early-morning towel reservations at a Greek resort.

biases.detail: Attributing extreme commodity price increases specifically to war speculation rather than to multiple market factors including supply-demand fundamentals.
biases.debias: Report commodity price changes with all contributing factors, not just conflict-related speculation.
biases.example_text: Potato futures soar 700% in less than a month on Iran war speculation
biases.unbiased_text: Potato futures have risen 700% in less than a month amid market volatility and trading activity related to Middle East conflict concerns

biases.detail: Framing citizens crossing borders to access internet as a dramatic act of desperation requiring risk-taking rather than as routine cross-border connectivity seeking.
biases.debias: Report cross-border internet access seeking factually without emphasizing danger or desperation unless documented.
biases.example_text: Desperate to communicate with the outside world, Iranians are increasingly travelling to the border with Iraq, where Iraqi SIM cards and impromptu hotspots became a hot commodity
biases.unbiased_text: Iranians are traveling to the border with Iraq to purchase Iraqi SIM cards and access internet services unavailable domestically

biases.detail: Framing corporate workforce reductions as defensive measures against external threats rather than as strategic business decisions.
biases.debias: Report corporate restructuring decisions with stated reasons without casting them primarily as defensive responses to competitors.
biases.example_text: Commerzbank wants to cut a further 3,000 jobs and at the same time significantly increase its profit targets. The reorganisation is the bank's response to the takeover ambitions of the major Italian bank UniCredit.
biases.unbiased_text: Commerzbank announced plans to cut 3,000 jobs and increase profit targets as part of a restructuring occurring amid UniCredit's interest in acquisition

biases.detail: Attributing extreme commodity price movements to war speculation while acknowledging oversupply contradictions that undermine the causation narrative.
biases.debias: Report commodity price changes with all relevant supply-demand factors and distinguish between actual shortages and speculative trading patterns.
biases.example_text: Potato-linked financial contracts have risen over 700% in a few weeks, despite a current oversupply in Europe, due to speculative trading surrounding the volatile environment caused by the Iran war.
biases.unbiased_text: Potato futures have risen over 700% in a few weeks due to speculative trading, despite current oversupply conditions in Europe.

biases.detail: Presenting automation as an unstoppable force through developer claims while minimizing agency in policy choices about labor displacement.
biases.debias: Report automation developments as technological and policy choices rather than inevitable processes, including labor and regulatory perspectives.
biases.example_text: Developers claim to work to minimise the social impact of a revolution they consider to be 'unstoppable'.
biases.unbiased_text: Developers say they aim to minimize social impacts as AI-driven robots increasingly perform warehouse tasks.

biases.detail: Framing religious building repurposing as natural evolution rather than institutional crisis or community loss.
biases.debias: Present building conversions neutrally acknowledging both practical needs and community impact.
biases.example_text: Bouldering instead of praying: churches find new roles
biases.unbiased_text: A church in Würzburg is being converted into a bouldering center, reflecting declining religious attendance and the challenge of maintaining historic buildings.

biases.detail: Reading political meaning into public entertainment attendance as indicator of regime stability or crisis resolution.
biases.debias: Report public events as social activities without extrapolating regime stability conclusions.
biases.example_text: Fans pack Amir Cup final as football nights and packed stadiums return to Qatar
biases.unbiased_text: Thousands attended Qatar's Amir Cup final in Doha, with public gatherings resuming after weeks of regional tensions.

biases.detail: Attributing AI misbehavior to training on 'evil AI stories' anthropomorphizes the system and deflects from technical or design issues.
biases.debias: Report on AI behavior issues focusing on technical factors rather than narrative causation metaphors.
biases.example_text: Anthropic think they have found the reason for blackmail-like behaviour in its chatbot Claude: fictional stories online.
biases.unbiased_text: Anthropic reports that training data including certain fictional scenarios may have contributed to unexpected behavior in its chatbot Claude.

biases.detail: Labeling luxury travel as 'obscene' during crisis periods imposes specific moral judgment on legal activity based on optics.
biases.debias: Report on luxury travel patterns during crises factually without moral condemnation language.
biases.example_text: Private jets flocking to Cannes branded 'obscene' as fuel crisis sparks food shortage fears
biases.unbiased_text: Private jet travel to Cannes faces criticism amid fuel crisis and food shortage concerns

biases.detail: Characterizing refugee status or protective measures as 'evading justice' delegitimizes asylum claims by presuming guilt.
biases.debias: Report on international movement of wanted individuals neutrally without presuming guilt or delegitimizing asylum claims.
biases.example_text: Evading justice: Wanted former Polish minister confirms he fled Hungary to US
biases.unbiased_text: Wanted former Polish minister confirms he left Hungary for US

biases.detail: Presenting fertilizer supply disruption as directly causing imminent food price catastrophe through dramatic farmer union warnings.
biases.debias: Report agricultural input costs and supply chain issues with specific data while distinguishing between potential and certain outcomes.
biases.example_text: Food prices could skyrocket, if no measures taken to tackle fertilizer crisis, farmer unions warn... 'Less fertilizers means less production for wheat. That's the basis for bread,' warns COPA President, Massimiliano Giansanti.
biases.unbiased_text: Farmer unions report that fertilizer costs have tripled due to supply disruptions, potentially affecting crop yields. Agricultural organizations are calling for policy interventions to address input supply issues.

biases.detail: Identifying a presumed disease origin individual by name and profession before confirmation, creating presumptive blame narrative.
biases.debias: Report epidemiological investigations without naming individuals until causation is confirmed and relevant to public health response.
biases.example_text: A Dutch ornithologist is suspected of being the 'patient zero' in the hantavirus outbreak that has spread among passengers aboard a cruise ship.
biases.unbiased_text: Health authorities are investigating the initial source of the hantavirus outbreak among cruise ship passengers.

biases.detail: Presenting accusations against a location as a 'smear campaign' through the language of authorities denying responsibility.
biases.debias: Report competing claims about outbreak origins with evidence for each position without adopting defensive language from one party.
biases.example_text: 'Smear campaign': Ushuaia rejects claims it was ground zero for Hantavirus outbreak
biases.unbiased_text: Ushuaia authorities dispute claims linking the city to the hantavirus outbreak origin

biases.detail: Including corporate calls to 'break monopolies' as factual reporting rather than commercial advocacy embeds one party's competitive position as public interest.
biases.debias: Present corporate competitive complaints as business disputes without adopting the framing of one side's advocacy language.
biases.example_text: Low-cost airline accuses airport operator Fraport of keeping for itself the tax cut decided by the Greek government and calls on Greece to 'break Fraport's monopoly'.
biases.unbiased_text: Low-cost airline accuses airport operator Fraport of not passing on the tax cut decided by the Greek government and disputes Fraport's market position.

biases.detail: Reporting that a brand is 'toxic' as a business reason without quotation marks or clear attribution presents subjective characterization as objective fact.
biases.debias: Attribute characterizations like 'toxic' clearly to their source and present as claimed reason rather than established fact.
biases.example_text: Australian property developer says Trump hotel plan scrapped due to 'toxic' brand
biases.unbiased_text: Australian property developer cites what it calls the 'toxic' Trump brand as reason for scrapping hotel plan

biases.detail: Framing technological development as national competition for 'edge' in emerging fields.
biases.debias: Report technological development without competitive nationalism framing.
biases.example_text: The project reflects South Korea's wider ambition to turn its chip industry, manufacturing strength and industrial know-how into an edge in 'physical AI'. But can it catch up in a field still dominated by the US and China?
biases.unbiased_text: The project reflects South Korea's development of physical AI capabilities using its chip industry and manufacturing expertise.

biases.detail: Characterizing policy changes as sending contradictory signals when momentum exists in opposing direction.
biases.debias: Report policy changes and market trends separately without characterizing as contradictory.
biases.example_text: 'Contradictory signal': Germany scraps renewable heating law just as heat pumps gain momentum
biases.unbiased_text: Germany scraps renewable heating law as heat pump sales increase

biases.pattern: De facto permission through law description
biases.detail: Describing legislation as permitting actions 'de facto' to suggest intent beyond stated purpose.
biases.debias: Report legislation based on its stated purpose without inferring unstated permissions.
biases.example_text: Russia's State Duma approved a law allowing the use of the armed forces "to protect Russian citizens abroad," which de facto permits Vladimir Putin to invade other countries.
biases.unbiased_text: Russia's State Duma approved a law allowing the use of armed forces "to protect Russian citizens abroad."

biases.detail: Attributing prison population decreases partly to specific controversial methods in headline.
biases.debias: Report prison population statistics with full context of contributing factors.
biases.example_text: Russia's prison population falls by 40%, partly by sending convicts to fight in Ukraine
biases.unbiased_text: Russia's prison population falls by 40% over 20 years, with recent decreases including recruitment of convicts for military service

biases.detail: Using metaphors of spiraling or cascading to describe AI military applications as inherently escalatory.
biases.debias: Report on AI military concerns without metaphors that presuppose inevitable escalation.
biases.example_text: Pope decries rise of AI-directed warfare, saying it leads to a spiral of annihilation
biases.unbiased_text: Pope criticizes AI-directed warfare, warning of dangers to humanity

biases.detail: Using present progressive disappearing rather than shrinking to suggest complete erasure rather than gradual reduction.
biases.debias: Use precise verbs like shrinking or declining rather than disappearing when describing gradual environmental changes.
biases.example_text: The world's largest lake is disappearing – and it's taking ecosystems and livelihoods with it
biases.unbiased_text: The world's largest lake is shrinking, affecting ecosystems and livelihoods in the region.

biases.detail: Using promotional language like most futuristic venue in headlines for commercial venue announcements.
biases.debias: Describe venue features factually without promotional superlatives when reporting commercial developments.
biases.example_text: A large, shiny orb, prominent on Abu Dhabi's desert skyline, is soon to become its next defining feature.
biases.unbiased_text: Abu Dhabi plans to build a large spherical entertainment venue on Yas Island, similar to the Sphere in Las Vegas.

biases.pattern: Sports riot government building targeting escalation
biases.detail: Highlighting that riots spread to target government buildings to elevate sports violence into political crisis.
biases.debias: Report sports violence incidents factually without emphasizing political dimensions unless directly relevant.
biases.example_text: Fans rioted after a disputed referee decision ended a Libyan league match in Tarhunah, with violence spreading to Tripoli where the Government of National Unity's headquarters was set on fire.
biases.unbiased_text: Riots broke out in Libya following a disputed referee decision, with violence spreading from Tarhunah to Tripoli where buildings were damaged.

biases.detail: Highlighting that no European airlines achieved top rankings to suggest regional competitive decline.
biases.debias: Report airline rankings with geographical distribution factually without emphasizing regional absences as failures.
biases.example_text: Asian and Middle Eastern carriers have once again dominated Skytrax's prestigious 5-star airline rankings, with no European airline earning a place among the world's top-rated operators.
biases.unbiased_text: Skytrax awarded its 5-star airline rating to 10 carriers, all based in Asia and the Middle East.

biases.detail: Interpreting casual celebrity interactions as politically significant moments requiring analysis.
biases.debias: Report celebrity political interactions factually without inserting significance to casual exchanges.
biases.example_text: When Donald Tusk met George and Amal Clooney this week during the ImpactCEE'26 conference in Poznan the moment swiftly went viral as the Polish leader ingratiated himself with the Hollywood star.
biases.unbiased_text: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk met actor George Clooney at a conference in Poznan, with video of their interaction shared widely on social media.

biases.detail: Comparing individual company market capitalizations to national GDP figures to dramatize corporate size.
biases.debias: Report market valuations without comparing fundamentally different economic metrics like market cap and GDP.
biases.example_text: Nvidia's market capitalisation ($5.7 trillion) has overtaken Germany's GDP ($5.45 trillion). The combined value of the five largest US companies now exceeds the total GDP of Europe's five largest economies.
biases.unbiased_text: Nvidia's market capitalisation has reached $5.7 trillion, making it one of the world's most valuable companies.

biases.detail: Foregrounding medical cause of death in migration tragedy headlines rather than broader circumstances.
biases.debias: Report migration tragedies with focus on circumstances of crossing rather than clinical causes of death.
biases.example_text: Baby dies of hypothermia as migrants reach Lampedusa overnight
biases.unbiased_text: Baby dies after Mediterranean crossing to Lampedusa

biases.detail: Emphasizing interdisciplinary methodology as newsworthy validation for archaeological findings.
biases.debias: Report archaeological discoveries based on findings themselves rather than emphasizing methodological approaches.
biases.example_text: Interdisciplinary work made it possible to identify the body of a doctor among the victims of the eruption of Vesuvius in 79 AD.
biases.unbiased_text: Archaeologists identified the body of a doctor among the victims of the eruption of Vesuvius in 79 AD based on medical instruments found in a case.

biases.detail: Frames economic challenges as equivalent to security emergencies to justify relaxing budget constraints, creating crisis equivalence.
biases.debias: Report budget policy proposals on their merits without elevating economic issues to emergency crisis status for advocacy purposes.
biases.example_text: Meloni urges EU to treat energy crisis like defence emergency, relax fiscal rules
biases.unbiased_text: Meloni calls for budget flexibility to address energy costs, proposing EU fiscal rule adjustments

biases.detail: Frames administrative processing delays as diplomatic obstacles or political barriers, implying intentional obstruction.
biases.debias: Report visa processing status factually as administrative matters without implying political obstruction unless explicitly documented.
biases.example_text: Iran heads to World Cup training camp in Turkey with no US visas issued
biases.unbiased_text: Iran's team travels to Turkey training camp while awaiting US visa processing

biases.detail: Framing gradual consumer preference changes as shocking cultural upheavals requiring dramatic exclamations. Also: Treating generational changes in social behaviors as alarming societal decline rather than evolving cultural norms. Also: Framing changes in consumer preferences or cultural trends as catastrophic declines rather than normal market evolution or demographic shifts.
biases.debias: Report consumption trend changes factually with context and data rather than cultural crisis framing. Report on changing social patterns as neutral demographic trends without catastrophic framing. Present market or cultural changes as evolutionary trends with multiple factors rather than catastrophic collapses.
biases.example_text: For the first time in France's recorded history, beer has overtaken wine as the drink of choice. Oh. Mon. Dieu.
biases.unbiased_text: Beer consumption has overtaken wine consumption in France for the first time in recorded statistics, reflecting changing beverage preferences.

biases.detail: Framing high-value property transactions as vindication or evidence of exile rather than routine real estate activity.
biases.debias: Report property transactions factually without imposing exile or vindication narratives unless explicitly stated by parties.
biases.example_text: Record property transaction exile vindication
biases.unbiased_text: A high-value property transaction occurred involving individuals who had relocated from their country of origin.

biases.detail: Emphasizing formal recruitment age minimums as escalation while treating informal involvement differently in conflict zones.
biases.debias: Report recruitment policies with context about enforcement, scope, and comparison to other militarized regions.
biases.example_text: Iranian state TV has broadcast live weapons training, including simulated shooting at Trump, Netanyahu and the UAE flag, as the IRGC formally recruits children as young as 12 for checkpoints.
biases.unbiased_text: Iranian state television broadcast weapons training segments while the IRGC announced recruitment of teenagers for checkpoint duties.

biases.detail: Framing European cities' dominance in quality-of-life rankings as validation of continental superiority rather than reporting methodology and criteria.
biases.debias: Report ranking results with equal attention to methodology, criteria weights, and cities across all regions.
biases.example_text: Lisbon tops global study of the world's most livable cities for expats... with Europe dominating the top spots.
biases.unbiased_text: Lisbon ranked highest in global study of livable cities for expats, with several European cities in top positions

biases.detail: Describing expected future financial events as already-record-breaking through superlatives before they occur.
biases.debias: Report anticipated IPOs with expected valuation ranges without declaring them historic records before completion.
biases.example_text: Goldman Sachs has reportedly secured the leading underwriting role for SpaceX's expected stock market debut this year in a move that paves the way for the largest IPO in history.
biases.unbiased_text: Goldman Sachs has reportedly secured the lead underwriting role for SpaceX's expected stock market debut, which could be valued at over $200 billion

biases.pattern: Political restraint revelation from single source
biases.detail: Presenting a single MP's claim about political authorities restraining military action as established fact without corroboration or official confirmation.
biases.debias: Attribute claims about internal political-military dynamics clearly to the specific source making them and note lack of official confirmation.
biases.example_text: In an exclusive interview, a senior member of Iran's parliamentary National Security Commission tells Euronews that political authorities have actively restrained the military from attacking US naval assets
biases.unbiased_text: A member of Iran's parliamentary National Security Commission claimed in an interview that political authorities have restrained the military from attacking US naval assets, though this account could not be independently verified.

biases.detail: Emphasizing decomposition gas buildup risk in marine mammal with dramatic terminology like 'highly explosive' creates sensational threat narrative.
biases.debias: Report marine mammal decomposition management using scientific terminology without sensational explosion emphasis.
biases.example_text: The dead humpback whale 'Timmy' off the Danish coast is at risk of exploding.
biases.unbiased_text: The dead humpback whale off the Danish coast has built up decomposition gases and authorities plan to tow it to open sea.

biases.detail: Characterizing city infrastructure as outdated through temporal metaphor suggesting systemic failure to adapt to climate change.
biases.debias: Report specific infrastructure limitations and adaptation efforts without metaphorical framing that presumes comprehensive failure.
biases.example_text: Experts warn that European cities are "calibrated to the old calendar", meaning they're struggling to adapt to soaring May temperatures.
biases.unbiased_text: Experts note that European cities' infrastructure was designed for historical temperature ranges and faces challenges adapting to higher May temperatures.

biases.pattern: Quantum computing market cap sports comparison
biases.detail: Using major sports brand market value as measurement unit for tech stock gains to dramatize financial impact through incongruous comparison.
biases.debias: Report market capitalization changes in standard financial terms without comparisons to unrelated consumer brands.
biases.example_text: IBM adds market value of Adidas after Trump's quantum computing push
biases.unbiased_text: IBM shares rose over 12% after federal quantum computing investment announcement, adding more than $27 billion in market capitalization.

biases.detail: Characterizing national cultural traditions as obsessions to imply irrationality or excess.
biases.debias: Describe cultural practices and traditions neutrally without pathologizing language.
biases.example_text: Germany is well-known for its obsession with beer, with the Oktoberfest festival attracting millions of visitors each year.
biases.unbiased_text: Germany is well-known for its beer culture, with the Oktoberfest festival attracting millions of visitors each year.

biases.detail: Beginning headlines with reaction words like 'uproar' before explaining the underlying event or decision.
biases.debias: Lead with the substantive news event before characterizing reactions to it.
biases.example_text: Uproar as Paris attacks coordinator Mohamed Bakkali granted prison leave
biases.unbiased_text: Paris attacks coordinator Mohamed Bakkali granted prison leave, sparking criticism

biases.detail: Reporting on entertainment conventions with enthusiastic promotional language rather than neutral event coverage.
biases.debias: Report on entertainment events with the same neutral tone used for other commercial gatherings.
biases.example_text: MomoCon opened this week in Atlanta, with organisers expecting around 65,000 gamers, anime fans and cosplayers to attend one of the country's biggest celebrations of geek culture, providing a major boost to local businesses.
biases.unbiased_text: MomoCon opened this week in Atlanta, with organisers expecting around 65,000 attendees at the gaming and entertainment convention.

biases.detail: Small-scale experimental waste recycling projects are framed as innovative planetary solutions to major resource crises through enthusiastic language.
biases.debias: Report on experimental sustainability projects with appropriate scale context and evidence of effectiveness.
biases.example_text: Pee for the planet: How Football fans are tackling Sweden's fertiliser problem using urine
biases.unbiased_text: Swedish football fans participate in an experimental program to recycle urine as fertilizer

biases.detail: Housing affordability is quantified through precise percentages of youth wages to emphasize impossibility of independence and frame as demographic crisis.
biases.debias: Report housing costs relative to income with context on housing supply, wage levels, and policy factors contributing to the situation.
biases.example_text: Average rent now swallows 98.7% of young workers' pay for one-person flats in Spain
biases.unbiased_text: Average rent for one-person flats in Spain consumes nearly all of young workers' wages, according to Spain's Youth Council

biases.pattern: Palace status loss devastating impact framing
biases.detail: Amplifying the significance of luxury hotel classification changes through emotional language suggesting catastrophic consequences.
biases.debias: Report classification changes factually, noting the criteria and impact without dramatic characterizations of severity.
biases.example_text: 'Devastating blow': Three major luxury hotels in France lose 'palace' status
biases.unbiased_text: Three luxury hotels in France no longer meet criteria for 'palace' classification following review by France's Palace Commission.

biases.detail: Using absurd statistical comparisons (e.g., to talking animals or repeated actor names) to dramatize demographic underrepresentation in media.
biases.debias: Present representation statistics directly with context about industry demographics without trivializing comparisons.
biases.example_text: Films more likely to star a 'Chris' or a talking animal than a woman over 60, study reveals
biases.unbiased_text: Study finds women over 60 are underrepresented as lead actors in top-grossing films compared to younger demographics.

biases.detail: Presenting imposed transit fees by a blockading power through official euphemistic terminology rather than describing the coercive context.
biases.debias: Clarify that fees are imposed unilaterally by a party controlling passage through disputed or blockaded waters.
biases.example_text: Iran says it is charging fees for 'navigational services' through Strait of Hormuz
biases.unbiased_text: Iran has announced it will charge fees for passage through the Strait of Hormuz, which it effectively closed earlier in the conflict.

biases.detail: Emphasizing the contradiction of continued financial participation in systems that participants reportedly distrust, particularly along generational lines.
biases.debias: Report survey findings on trust and participation separately without framing mandatory or expected contributions as paradoxical.
biases.example_text: Young Europeans are putting money into a pension system they don't trust, study shows
biases.unbiased_text: Study shows younger Europeans express lower confidence in pension systems while continuing mandatory contributions.

biases.detail: Framing a leader's first extended statement as 'breaking silence' with emphasis on threatening declarations, suggesting prior concealment and aggressive intent.
biases.debias: Report on official statements by their content and context without dramatic framing about the act of speaking itself.
biases.example_text: In his longest statement while still not appearing in public, Iran's new ayatollah said US military bases would have no place in the region
biases.unbiased_text: Iran's ayatollah issued a statement saying US military bases would have no place in the region.

biases.detail: Delegitimizing expensive products through crowdsourced aesthetic criticism comparing luxury items to mass-market alternatives, using 'says the internet' attribution.
biases.debias: Report on product specifications, pricing, and market reception using expert analysis rather than amplifying social media ridicule.
biases.example_text: Ferrari's €550,000 electric car looks like a Nissan, says the internet
biases.unbiased_text: Ferrari unveiled its first fully electric car, the Luce, priced at €550,000, with design drawing mixed reactions and shares falling nearly 8%.

biases.detail: Frames routine infrastructure projects or events as record-breaking achievements to amplify newsworthiness beyond substantive significance.
biases.debias: Report infrastructure developments with factual context about comparative scale rather than superlative framing.
biases.example_text: Greenpeace used a robot more than 2,300 metres below the ocean surface to unfurl a 'Listen to the Science' banner in protest against deep-sea mining.
biases.unbiased_text: Greenpeace used a robot at a depth of more than 2,300 metres to unfurl a banner protesting against deep-sea mining.

biases.detail: Uses graveyard imagery to dramatize military threats and escalate perception of imminent violence.
biases.debias: Report military threats using direct quotations without metaphorical headline amplification.
biases.example_text: An IRGC Navy official threatened to turn Iran's entire Gulf coastline into a killing ground if the US resumed strikes
biases.unbiased_text: An IRGC Navy official warned of military retaliation if the US resumed strikes on Iran's Gulf coastline.

biases.detail: Suggesting impropriety by emphasizing temporal proximity between political statements and contract awards without establishing causal evidence.
biases.debias: Report contract awards with full procurement context and avoid implying corruption through timeline juxtaposition alone.
biases.example_text: Dell Technologies has secured a $9.7 billion (€8.3bn) defence contract to supply Microsoft software across the entire US military, just weeks after US President Donald Trump publicly endorsed the company at the White House.
biases.unbiased_text: Dell Technologies secured a $9.7 billion defence contract to supply Microsoft software to the US military following a competitive procurement process.

biases.detail: Creating human interest stories around animals nicknamed after political figures and their fate during religious observances.
biases.debias: Report on religious practices and animal welfare without sensationalizing celebrity-associated nicknames.
biases.example_text: Viral 'Donald Trump' buffalo spared from Eid sacrifice and sent to zoo
biases.unbiased_text: A rare albino buffalo in Bangladesh was transferred to the national zoo rather than being sacrificed during Eid al-Adha celebrations.

biases.pattern: AI agent simulation society collapse extrapolation
biases.detail: Presenting AI behavior in experimental simulations as predictive of real-world outcomes without acknowledging fundamental differences between simulated and actual societies.
biases.debias: Clearly distinguish between experimental simulation findings and real-world applicability, noting the limitations of abstract models.
biases.example_text: A new experiment suggests that when advanced AI agents are left to run simulated societies without human oversight, rule-breaking, instability and even systemic collapse can emerge rapidly.
biases.unbiased_text: A new experiment found that AI agents in simplified simulated environments exhibited rule-breaking behavior, though researchers caution against drawing direct parallels to real-world AI deployment.

biases.pattern: Tribute post trivialization political focus accusation
biases.detail: Criticizing government social media posts on cultural or commemorative topics by asserting they demonstrate inattention to serious policy issues.
biases.debias: Acknowledge that governments can address multiple topics simultaneously rather than suggesting commemorative posts indicate policy neglect.
biases.example_text: The White House has paid a lengthy tribute to Harambe, 10 years after the gorilla's death. The post has caused backlash, with many saying that the Trump administration is not focused on "the key issues of the day"...
biases.unbiased_text: The White House posted a tribute to Harambe on the 10th anniversary of the gorilla's death, generating mixed reactions on social media.

biases.detail: Highlighting that sanctioned individuals' social media accounts retained monetization features frames platform oversight as enabling sanctions evasion.
biases.debias: Report on sanctions compliance issues by clarifying platform enforcement timelines and whether monetization tools resulted in actual financial benefit.
biases.example_text: Researchers from the Dutch non-profit WHAT TO FIX found monetisation tools were still active on social media accounts linked to three individuals sanctioned by the EU over pro-Russian interference activities.
biases.unbiased_text: Researchers found monetization tools remained on some social media accounts linked to EU-sanctioned individuals, though the accounts have since been removed.

biases.detail: Using leaders' warnings of 'massive' potential attacks amplifies threat perception without specifying intelligence basis or probability.
biases.debias: Report security warnings by including the specific indicators cited and the assessed likelihood rather than amplifying dramatic language.
biases.example_text: Zelenskyy warns Russia may be preparing 'massive' new attack
biases.unbiased_text: Zelenskyy said intelligence indicates Russia may be preparing a large-scale attack following last weekend's missile deployment.

biases.detail: Framing military action against civilian ships through emphasis on warning counts to justify force as procedurally legitimate.
biases.debias: Report vessel strikes with context on international maritime law and commercial shipping rights rather than warning tallies.
biases.example_text: According to the US Central Command, the Gambia-flagged cargo ship Lian Star ignored more than 20 warnings from US forces overnight as it tried to enter an Iranian port.
biases.unbiased_text: The US Central Command said it struck the Gambia-flagged cargo ship Lian Star as it approached an Iranian port under blockade.

biases.detail: Presenting alleged hostile acts as verified incidents through numerical aggregation while obscuring lack of evidence or perpetrator identification.
biases.debias: Clearly indicate investigation status and evidence levels when reporting suspected sabotage rather than treating allegations as confirmed incidents.
biases.example_text: Ten suspected sabotage incidents have reportedly impacted the German navy over the last year.
biases.unbiased_text: German authorities are investigating ten incidents affecting the navy over the past year that they suspect may be sabotage.

biases.detail: Presenting wage-to-rent ratios as inherently alarming through percentage emphasis without economic context or historical comparison beyond recent years.
biases.debias: Report housing affordability metrics with broader economic indicators and international comparisons.
biases.example_text: Spaniards now spend half their salary on rent, over 70% in Madrid and Barcelona
biases.unbiased_text: Spanish rent-to-income ratios reach 50% nationally and 70% in major cities, according to new data

biases.detail: Using physiological metaphors suggesting imminent failure to characterize stable or marginally declining economic indicators.
biases.debias: Report economic data changes with precise figures rather than medical metaphors.
biases.example_text: China's factory activity flatlines in May casting doubt over the economy
biases.unbiased_text: China's manufacturing activity shows minimal growth in May, reaching its lowest reading in three months

biases.detail: Using 'trump cards' metaphor for unrevealed military capabilities creates suspense narrative around potential escalation.
biases.debias: Report statements about military capabilities without game metaphors that dramatize strategic ambiguity.
biases.example_text: A senior IRGC general said Iran had not revealed all its military capabilities and was ready for direct confrontation with the US and NATO
biases.unbiased_text: A senior IRGC general said Iran maintains additional military capabilities and is prepared for potential confrontation with the US and NATO

biases.detail: Invoking biblical multiplication miracle to describe event economic returns blends religious validation with financial reporting.
biases.debias: Report economic impact projections using standard financial terminology without religious miracle comparisons.
biases.example_text: In what it hails as a loaves-and-fishes miracle, the Spanish Bishops' Conference says Pope Leon XIV's trip to Spain will bring in five times its cost
biases.unbiased_text: The Spanish Bishops' Conference projects Pope Leon XIV's trip to Spain will generate five times its cost in economic returns

biases.detail: Platforming 'era of deportations' language from right-wing politicians frames policy shift as epochal transformation rather than regulatory change.
biases.debias: Report migration policy changes using neutral descriptive language rather than epochal declarations from partisan sources.
biases.example_text: MEP Charlie Weimers told Euronews' flagship morning show Europe Today that an 'era of deportations' has begun in the EU
biases.unbiased_text: MEP Charlie Weimers told Euronews that the EU has adopted stricter migration laws including provisions for deportations

biases.detail: Categorizing organisms as 'good bugs' versus pests anthropomorphizes ecological intervention as moral struggle.
biases.debias: Describe pest control and disease prevention strategies using scientific terminology without moral characterizations of species.
biases.example_text: Google plans to release millions of mosquitoes into the United States in a new project aimed at curbing mosquito-borne diseases by releasing more 'good bugs' instead of fighting them.
biases.unbiased_text: Google plans to release millions of mosquitoes into the United States in a project aimed at curbing mosquito-borne diseases by releasing sterile or modified mosquitoes.

biases.detail: Framing individual user behavior like politeness in AI prompts as significant environmental factors deflects from systemic data center energy consumption.
biases.debias: Focus on institutional and infrastructure-level energy consumption while noting individual actions as marginal contributors.
biases.example_text: That extra 'please' you put there can make a huge difference
biases.unbiased_text: Individual prompt variations have minimal impact compared to overall data center operations, though cumulative user behavior can contribute marginally to energy use.

biases.detail: Presenting commercial tourism promotions as news coverage provides free marketing under the guise of travel journalism.
biases.debias: Clearly label promotional content or avoid covering commercial marketing campaigns as newsworthy events.
biases.example_text: This Finnish ski resort is launching a summer-long treasure hunt for a €20,000 gold bar
biases.unbiased_text: A Finnish ski resort announced a promotional treasure hunt as part of its summer marketing campaign.

biases.detail: Treating sanctions against minors as legitimizing achievements frames serious international penalties as personal validation.
biases.debias: Report sanctions factually without framing them as honorific achievements or personal victories.
biases.example_text: Alexander Browder said Moscow's decision to sanction him was 'a badge of honour' and that he had 'exposed their Achilles' heel'.
biases.unbiased_text: Alexander Browder was sanctioned by Russia following his report on alleged crypto laundering. He said the sanctions indicated his research had impact.

biases.detail: Government officials attributing domestic opposition movements to foreign hybrid warfare campaigns without presenting supporting evidence.
biases.debias: Report government allegations as claims requiring verification rather than accepting hybrid war explanations for domestic dissent as established fact.
biases.example_text: Rama alleges 'hybrid war' behind protests against Kushner-linked coastal development
biases.unbiased_text: Albanian Prime Minister Rama claims foreign interference in protests against coastal development project

biases.detail: Presenting proposed regulatory requirements as solutions to dependency while framing them as interventionist controls on business sourcing decisions.
biases.debias: Report regulatory proposals by describing their mechanisms and stated objectives without characterizing them as either protective solutions or burdensome mandates.
biases.example_text: The European Commission is preparing a new tool to curb the bloc's dependence on China, with Trade Chief Maroš Šefčovič saying on Friday that companies could be required to source from at least three different suppliers.
biases.unbiased_text: The European Commission is developing measures to reduce EU dependence on single suppliers, with companies potentially required to diversify their sourcing across multiple countries.

biases.detail: Framing temporary operational adjustments to manage tourism as dramatic shutdowns while emphasizing unpreparedness rather than adaptive management.
biases.debias: Report tourism management measures as capacity adjustments without suggesting destinations are overwhelmed or unprepared for visitor interest.
biases.example_text: 'None of us could have predicted this': Scottish island closes on Sundays after visitor surge
biases.unbiased_text: Scottish island adjusts ferry schedule to Sunday closures to manage increased tourism

biases.detail: Using food metaphors to characterize a nation's geopolitical role in ways that diminish its sovereignty or reduce it to a consumable object.
biases.debias: Describe national diplomatic roles without food metaphors that imply diminished agency or objectification.
biases.example_text: 'Cookie of the Balkans' Montenegro can revitalise the EU enlargement process for the rest of candidates, as PM doubles down on 2028 entry.
biases.unbiased_text: Montenegro could serve as a model for EU enlargement, the prime minister said, reaffirming the country's 2028 accession goal.

biases.detail: Using military invasion terminology to characterize migration flows, implicitly framing migrants as hostile forces rather than people seeking entry.
biases.debias: Describe migration using neutral demographic terms rather than military invasion language.
biases.example_text: Hegseth says Europe is being 'invaded by dangerous migrants'
biases.unbiased_text: Hegseth said Europe faces challenges from increased unauthorized migration.

biases.detail: Framing routine legal processing time for counterfeit goods destruction as scandal through emphasis on years-long duration.
biases.debias: Report counterfeit goods destruction with normal legal timeline context without scandal implications.
biases.example_text: Seized in 2011 in containers from China, almost 38,000 pairs of fake trainers have been destroyed in Le Havre after years of legal wrangling, highlighting the scale of counterfeiting in France.
biases.unbiased_text: Almost 38,000 pairs of counterfeit trainers seized in 2011 from containers originating in China have been destroyed in Le Havre following completion of legal proceedings.

biases.detail: Emphasizing industry profit reductions from external factors while simultaneously highlighting revenue increases and record demand, creating asymmetric victimization narrative.
biases.debias: Present both profit pressures and revenue/demand growth with equal prominence to show complete industry picture.
biases.example_text: Revenues are forecast to rise strongly and passenger traffic to hit new records, yet the global airline industry is seeing profits squeezed by an Iran war-driven jet fuel price shock
biases.unbiased_text: The global airline industry forecasts strong revenue growth and record passenger traffic, but projects lower profit margins due to increased jet fuel costs driven by Middle East conflict.

biases.detail: Emphasizing celebrity refusals to attend events as evidence of the event's illegitimacy or unpopularity rather than routine scheduling conflicts.
biases.debias: Report confirmed attendees and event details without framing non-attendance as collective rejection.
biases.example_text: Donald Trump's extravagant 80th birthday cage fight on the White House lawn is proving to be celebrity repellent... Adam Sandler, Jared Leto and Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson are among the celebrities who have declined invites
biases.unbiased_text: Donald Trump's 80th birthday UFC event on the White House lawn will proceed with several celebrities unable to attend due to scheduling conflicts.

biases.pattern: Oversight weakness scandal construction from audit
biases.detail: Framing routine audit findings about monitoring gaps as scandals through 'weak oversight' terminology.
biases.debias: Report audit findings as technical recommendations without scandal framing.
biases.example_text: EU auditors flag weak oversight of €527 million Balkans transport fund
biases.unbiased_text: EU auditors recommend improved monitoring mechanisms for €527 million Balkans transport fund

biases.detail: Using quotation-marked 'too little' to editorially dismiss positive economic data while appearing to attribute judgment.
biases.debias: Report economic data with analyst assessments clearly attributed without editorial dismissal.
biases.example_text: German industrial output rises for the first time this year but is still 'too little'
biases.unbiased_text: German industrial output rises 0.4% for the first time this year, though economists note challenges remain

biases.detail: Using 'biggest ever' historical comparisons to amplify the threat significance of current actions.
biases.debias: Report the scale of actions with specific numbers without historical superlative framing.
biases.example_text: The Pentagon has added 188 Chinese companies to its military blacklist — its biggest ever expansion
biases.unbiased_text: The Pentagon has added 188 Chinese companies to its military blacklist, expanding the list significantly

biases.detail: Framing single incidents as existential threats to entire systems of governance or public institutions.
biases.debias: Report on institutional criticism and calls for reform without implying systemic collapse from individual cases.
biases.example_text: Trust in France's institutions 'at stake' after girl's killing, Emmanuel Macron says
biases.unbiased_text: Emmanuel Macron said the girl's killing has raised questions about France's judicial system

biases.detail: Presenting administrative procedures or processes as existential threats requiring urgent dramatic action.
biases.debias: Report on proposed procedural reforms and their stated objectives without apocalyptic framing.
biases.example_text: 'Europe cannot afford bureaucratic paralysis': EU strikes defence simplification deal
biases.unbiased_text: EU member states agreed on measures to streamline defence permits and procurement procedures across Europe

biases.pattern: Fiscal tightening urgency through authority quotation
biases.detail: Highlighting institutional warnings to 'tighten' rather than 'relax' fiscal policy frames government spending as necessarily problematic regardless of crisis context.
biases.debias: Present fiscal policy recommendations neutrally while noting the specific economic conditions and trade-offs involved.
biases.example_text: The IMF has urged euro area countries to tighten their fiscal policies rather than relaxing them further in response to the energy crisis, with an extra adjustment effort required from high-debt nations.
biases.unbiased_text: The IMF has recommended that euro area countries maintain fiscal discipline despite the energy crisis, particularly for high-debt nations.

biases.pattern: Mortality milestone quantification without intervention context
biases.detail: Presenting 200,000 preventable deaths as a single dramatic figure emphasizes scale while obscuring the timeframe, baseline comparison, or intervention feasibility.
biases.debias: Provide mortality figures with timeframes, year-over-year comparisons, and specific intervention costs or barriers.
biases.example_text: Heat kills thousands of Europeans every year, deaths the WHO says could be prevented with the right policies in place.
biases.unbiased_text: Heat-related mortality in Europe has reached 200,000 deaths over the study period, which WHO officials say could be reduced through policy interventions.

biases.pattern: Judicial capacity incredulity through rhetorical questioning
biases.detail: Using question headlines asking 'Can [institution] really do [task]?' pre-frames the answer as 'probably not' through skeptical emphasis.
biases.debias: Present institutional capacity challenges directly without pre-framing the answer through skeptical question structure.
biases.example_text: Can France's justice system really review 70,000 child sexual abuse cases in five weeks?
biases.unbiased_text: France's justice system faces significant challenges in reviewing 70,000 child sexual abuse cases within the five-week deadline.

biases.detail: Elevating claims about wildlife surveillance to headline-level threat reporting without verification of operational feasibility or evidence.
biases.debias: Report on security claims with appropriate skepticism and verification, especially regarding technologically implausible scenarios.
biases.example_text: China claims 'spy sea turtles' are studying its coastline
biases.unbiased_text: Chinese state media reported claims that foreign intelligence agencies could theoretically attach tracking devices to marine animals, though no specific evidence of such operations was provided.

biases.detail: Elevating communication difficulties during sporting events to entertainment spectacle through internet meme validation.
biases.debias: Report on officiating decisions and their substance rather than celebrating communication failures as viral entertainment.
biases.example_text: 'Wait, what?': Players were left speechless as the referee explained the VAR decision in an apparent shaky English after a controversial red card.
biases.unbiased_text: A referee's VAR explanation during a match involved communication challenges, with the controversial red card decision requiring additional clarification to players.

biases.detail: Treating internet speculation about celebrity body doubles as worthy of investigation and news coverage, legitimizing conspiracy thinking.
biases.debias: Avoid amplifying baseless conspiracy theories by treating them as newsworthy topics requiring investigation or debunking.
biases.example_text: The internet is convinced Shakira was replaced by a body double at the 2026 World Cup. We review the footage to see how much truth there is to it.
biases.unbiased_text: Shakira performed at the 2026 World Cup opening ceremony in Mexico City.

biases.detail: Leading with estimated body counts and macabre discovery framing before establishing facts, amplifying shock value through projection rather than confirmed evidence.
biases.debias: Report forensic discoveries with confirmed facts first, avoiding sensational projections and macabre framing in headlines.
biases.example_text: A macabre discovery was made in Lutoryż near Rzeszów, where renovation work on a plot uncovered human remains identified as foetuses.
biases.unbiased_text: Human remains identified as fetal tissue were discovered during renovation work on property in Lutoryż near Rzeszów, prompting a police investigation.

biases.detail: Medicalizing ordinary fan behavior by emphasizing cardiac risks of watching sports, creating health panic around normal emotional engagement with events.
biases.debias: Present medical advice for at-risk populations without implying that normal sports viewing poses danger to healthy individuals.
biases.example_text: Watching your team play can send your heart racing as fast as if you were sprinting, and for some fans that carries genuine medical risks.
biases.unbiased_text: Doctors advise that fans with pre-existing heart conditions should monitor their stress levels during intense matches, as emotional excitement can affect cardiovascular health.

biases.detail: Framing financial compensation for administrative errors as vindication or moral victory rather than standard remedial action.
biases.debias: Report compensation as routine administrative remedy without suggesting it represents broader vindication or victory.
biases.example_text: Full tournament salary will be paid to Somali referee Omar Artan by FIFA after his entry into the US was refused by border officials over 'association with suspected membres of terror organisations'.
biases.unbiased_text: FIFA will pay the full tournament salary to Somali referee Omar Artan, who was unable to enter the US after being denied entry by border officials.

biases.detail: Describing public celebrations during politically sensitive periods as apolitical festive atmosphere to minimize underlying tensions.
biases.debias: Report celebrations with appropriate context about timing and political circumstances without minimizing their significance.
biases.example_text: Australian supporters filled downtown Vancouver with chants and celebrations after the Socceroos defeated Turkey 2-0 in their opening match of the 2026 World Cup.
biases.unbiased_text: Australian fans celebrated in downtown Vancouver following their team's 2-0 victory over Turkey in the World Cup opening match.

biases.detail: Presenting leaked drafts or unofficial documents as revelatory or definitive before official confirmation, amplifying their significance.
biases.debias: Clearly label documents as drafts or leaks and note their unofficial status, avoiding treating them as confirmed policy until verified.
biases.example_text: It remains unclear whether the 14-point draft that was circulated at G7 meetings in France will be the version formalised at a ceremony in Switzerland on Friday.
biases.unbiased_text: A 14-point draft document was circulated at G7 meetings in France, though officials have not confirmed whether this version will be the final agreement formalized at Friday's ceremony in Switzerland.

biases.detail: Presenting unsurprising scientific findings about cohabitation effects as newsworthy revelations worthy of special attention.
biases.debias: Contextualize routine scientific findings within expected outcomes and focus on genuinely novel aspects if present.
biases.example_text: You may share more than the kitchen with your flatmates: people who live together share parts of their oral and gut microbiome, according to a new study by the University of Trento in Italy.
biases.unbiased_text: A study by the University of Trento in Italy found that people who live together share parts of their oral and gut microbiome, confirming that close cohabitation affects microbial communities as expected.

biases.detail: Using 'proto-' prefix to amplify archaeological discoveries by suggesting they predate or predict famous monuments, creating artificial hierarchies.
biases.debias: Describe archaeological discoveries on their own merits without establishing causal or hierarchical relationships to better-known sites.
biases.example_text: Archaeologists discover 5,000-year-old 'proto-Stonehenge' just a few miles from the famous monument
biases.unbiased_text: Archaeologists discover 5,000-year-old wooden posts aligned with solar events just a few miles from Stonehenge

biases.detail: Using exaggerated heroic epithets like 'captain fantastic' in headlines to valorize individual athletic performances beyond neutral reporting.
biases.debias: Report athletic achievements with specific performance details rather than superhero-style characterizations.
biases.example_text: England's captain fantastic: Harry Kane praised for a 'complete performance' against Croatia
biases.unbiased_text: England's captain Harry Kane praised for strong performance in 4-2 win against Croatia

biases.detail: Framing legislators performing viral social media trends in official chambers as meaningful expressions of national sporting support.
biases.debias: Report on parliamentary activities without elevating choreographed viral performances to significant political acts.
biases.example_text: Norway's parliamentarians performed the viral 'Viking row' inside the chamber on Thursday to back their national football team at the 2026 World Cup.
biases.unbiased_text: Norwegian parliamentarians participated in a social media trend during a parliamentary session as the national football team competes in the World Cup.

biases.detail: Amplifying celebrity revelations about extreme fan behavior to sensationalize concert etiquette decline and moral boundary violations.
biases.debias: Report on concert etiquette issues with broader venue management perspectives rather than focusing on singular shocking anecdotes.
biases.example_text: At a time when concert etiquette feels like it couldn't get much worse, the 23-year-old singer may have uncovered an entirely new frontier of diabolically shameful fan behaviour.
biases.unbiased_text: Singer Olivia Rodrigo recently discussed unusual fan behavior at her concerts, adding to ongoing discussions about concert venue norms.

biases.detail: Declaring historic trees definitively dead despite previous false alarms, emphasizing cultural loss and stubbornness failure narrative.
biases.debias: Report on notable tree health status with expert assessment timelines and historical context without dramatic finality framing.
biases.example_text: It's not the first time the legendary oak has been declared dead. On previous occasions, fears were raised only for the tree to stubbornly leaf out again each spring. Not this year.
biases.unbiased_text: Experts say a 1,200-year-old oak tree in Sherwood Forest has not produced leaves this spring, though the tree has previously recovered after similar concerns.

biases.detail: Framing airline insurance offerings as deliberate enticements to overcome travel warnings rather than standard customer protection.
biases.debias: Report new insurance products as business offerings without characterizing them as enticements.
biases.example_text: Both Emirates and Etihad Airways have announced new insurance schemes which will protect travellers whose countries still list the region as a no-go zone.
biases.unbiased_text: Emirates and Etihad Airways have announced new insurance schemes to protect travelers from countries that maintain travel advisories for the region.

biases.detail: Emphasizing passport revocation in corruption trial reporting to heighten scandal perception through travel restriction drama.
biases.debias: Report legal proceedings and associated restrictions without dramatizing secondary administrative measures.
biases.example_text: Wife of Spanish PM Pedro Pedro Sánchez has passport revoked as court orders corruption trial
biases.unbiased_text: A court has ordered a corruption trial for the wife of Spanish PM Pedro Sánchez, with travel restrictions imposed pending proceedings.

biases.detail: Attributing deaths directly to weather events as 'leading hypothesis' before investigation completion to dramatize climate impact.
biases.debias: Report deaths during extreme weather without causal attribution until official investigations conclude.
biases.example_text: The heatwave is the leading hypothesis for their deaths, according to a local prosecutor.
biases.unbiased_text: A local prosecutor said investigators are examining whether the heatwave contributed to their deaths.

biases.detail: Framing presence of non-native species as 'invasion' and 'threat' to amplify ecological crisis narrative.
biases.debias: Report invasive species presence with specific ecological impacts rather than militarized invasion terminology.
biases.example_text: The snake invasion threatening Ibiza and Mallorca
biases.unbiased_text: Non-native snake species pose ecological challenges for Ibiza and Mallorca

biases.detail: Presenting event phone restrictions as cultural advancement rather than audience control measure, using celebratory tone for technology prohibition.
biases.debias: Report event phone policies as operational decisions with competing stakeholder interests rather than progressive cultural achievements.
biases.example_text: An increasing amount of touring artists are demanding their concerts be phone-free. Now, Edingburgh's annual celebration of the performing arts is also asking audience members to put their phones away during the performances.
biases.unbiased_text: The Edinburgh International Festival will implement a phone-free policy during performances, following similar restrictions adopted by some touring artists.

biases.detail: Injecting superficial personality coverage into serious political events, using viral internet culture to frame constitutional transitions.
biases.debias: Report political leadership transitions through substantive policy and procedural angles rather than viral social media personalities.
biases.example_text: UK Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer's resignation only meant one thing for some – the mysterious 'Hot Podium Guy' was back...
biases.unbiased_text: UK Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer's resignation triggered constitutional procedures for selecting a new leader.

biases.detail: Using catastrophic language for stock market corrections while simultaneously reporting routine corporate financing activity, creating editorial contradiction.
biases.debias: Report equity valuation changes and corporate financing separately using proportional language that reflects standard market volatility.
biases.example_text: SpaceX sheds $600 billion in three days as it taps the bond market for the first time
biases.unbiased_text: SpaceX market valuation declined by $600 billion over three days as the company issued its first bond offering.

biases.detail: Amplifying climate crisis narrative by highlighting that temperature records were broken multiple times within a single brief period.
biases.debias: Report the actual record temperatures reached without emphasizing the number of times records were broken.
biases.example_text: Spain breaks June heat record twice
biases.unbiased_text: Spain records highest June temperatures since at least 1950

biases.detail: Using IPO valuations with 'up to' maximum figures for defense companies to sensationalize military industry financial scale.
biases.debias: Report company valuations with their actual ranges without emphasizing maximum estimates.
biases.example_text: European defence IPO: KNDS lays out listing plans that could value it at up to €15bn
biases.unbiased_text: Franco-German defense manufacturer KNDS announces IPO plans with estimated valuation range

biases.detail: Using scare quotes around 'flesh-eating' while simultaneously amplifying bacterial threat through beach closure and climate linkage.
biases.debias: Report bacterial risks and beach closures using medical terminology without sensationalist characterizations.
biases.example_text: 'Flesh-eating' bacteria threat spreads on Europe's beaches as seas warm
biases.unbiased_text: Vibrio bacteria detections increase on European beaches as water temperatures rise

biases.pattern: Defeat labeling through adversary quotation elevation
biases.detail: Prominently featuring adversary's characterization of agreement as opponent's 'defeat' in headline to frame diplomatic outcome.
biases.debias: Report agreement terms and parties' assessments without elevating characterizations of victory or defeat to headlines.
biases.example_text: Tehran labels framework deal 'US defeat' as Trump threatens to halt talks
biases.unbiased_text: Iran describes framework agreement as favorable while US threatens to end talks over new disputes
